Private Function Describe(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim title As String, position As String
    title = "[off]"
    position = "[off]"
    If target.HasTitle Then title = target.ChartTitle.Text
    If target.HasLegend Then position = CStr(target.Legend.Position)
    Describe = CStr(VarType(target)) & ":" & TypeName(target)
    Describe = Describe & "|title=" & CStr(target.HasTitle) & ":" & title
    Describe = Describe & "|legend=" & CStr(target.HasLegend) & ":" & position
    Describe = Describe & "|type=" & CStr(target.ChartType)
End Function

Public Function AdvancedChartMarker() As String

Public Function OfPieProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal splitKind As Long, ByVal splitValue As Double, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object, group As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    If explicitLabels Then
        n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    stage = "group"
    Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
    If splitKind <> 0 Then
        stage = "split-type"
        group.SplitType = splitKind
        stage = "split-value"
        group.SplitValue = splitValue
    End If
    stage = "read"
    OfPieProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|split=" & CStr(group.SplitType) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    OfPieProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function BubbleProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal inputSizes As Variant, ByVal sizesKind As Long, ByVal typeAfterData As Boolean, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    If Not typeAfterData Then target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
    If explicitLabels Then
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    If typeAfterData Then
        stage = "type-after"
        target.ChartType = kind
    End If
    If sizesKind = 1 Then
        stage = "sizes-literal"
        item.BubbleSizes = inputSizes
    ElseIf sizesKind = 2 Then
        stage = "sizes-range"
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            Ledger.Cells(i + 1, 3).Value2 = inputSizes(LBound(inputSizes) + i)
        Next
        item.BubbleSizes = Ledger.Range(Ledger.Cells(1, 3), Ledger.Cells(n, 3))
    End If
    stage = "read"
    BubbleProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|sizes=" & CStr(VarType(item.BubbleSizes)) & ":" & CStr(item.BubbleSizes)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    BubbleProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function StateReport() As String
    Dim index As Long, anchor As Object, report As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    report = "sheet=" & Describe(PlotHost) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(PlotHost)
    report = report & "|embedded=" & CStr(Ledger.ChartObjects.Count)
    For index = 1 To Ledger.ChartObjects.Count
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects(index)
        report = report & "|object=" & anchor.Name & ":" & Describe(anchor.Chart) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(anchor.Chart)
        report = report & "|bounds=" & CStr(anchor.Left) & ":" & CStr(anchor.Top)
        report = report & ":" & CStr(anchor.Width) & ":" & CStr(anchor.Height)
    Next index
    StateReport = report
    Exit Function
Failed:
    StateReport = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function CaseProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If kind = 0 Then
        CaseProbe = "oxi-uniform-chart-20261106-v2"
        Exit Function
    End If
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    Select Case kind
    Case 1
        ' Observe the original chart or the newly created embedded chart.
    Case 2
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 3
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = "Revenue"
        target.HasLegend = False
    Case 4
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ""
    Case 5
        target.HasTitle = False
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 6
        target.HasTitle = False
    Case 7
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4131
    Case 8
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4107
    Case 9
        target.HasLegend = False
        target.HasLegend = True
    Case 10
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ChrW(&H58F2) & ChrW(&H4E0A) & " & <" & ChrW(&H96C6) & ChrW(&H8A08) & ">" & vbLf & "2026"
    Case 11
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Caption = "Caption"
    Case 12
        target.ChartType = 51
    Case Else
        Err.Raise 5, "UniformChart", "Unknown case"
    End Select
    CaseProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|objects=" & CStr(Ledger.ChartObjects.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    CaseProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Private Function TypedValues(ByVal value As Variant) As String
    Dim index As Long, result As String
    result = CStr(VarType(value)) & ":" & TypeName(value)
    If IsArray(value) Then
        result = result & "[" & CStr(LBound(value)) & "," & CStr(UBound(value)) & "]"
        For index = LBound(value) To UBound(value)
            result = result & "{" & CStr(VarType(value(index))) & ":" & CStr(value(index)) & "}"
        Next index
    Else
        result = result & ":" & CStr(value)
    End If
    TypedValues = result
End Function

Private Function DescribeSeries(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim index As Long, item As Object, result As String
    result = CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
    For index = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection(index)
        result = result & "|series=" & item.Name & ":" & item.Formula
        result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
    Next index
    DescribeSeries = result
End Function

Public Function ChartTypeProbe(ByVal chartType As Long, ByVal sourceKind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = chartType
    If sourceKind = 1 Then
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
        item.Name = "Revenue"
        item.Values = Array(1.25, 2.5, 3.75)
        item.XValues = Array("1", "2", "3")
    ElseIf sourceKind = 2 Then
        Ledger.Range("A1").Value2 = "Category"
        Ledger.Range("B1").Value2 = "Revenue"
        Ledger.Range("A2").Value2 = 1
        Ledger.Range("A3").Value2 = 2
        Ledger.Range("A4").Value2 = 3
        Ledger.Range("B2").Value2 = 1.25
        Ledger.Range("B3").Value2 = 2.5
        Ledger.Range("B4").Value2 = 3.75
        target.SetSourceData Ledger.Range("A1:B4")
    End If
    ChartTypeProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    ChartTypeProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Private Function TypedValues(ByVal v As Variant) As String
 Dim i As Long, s As String

 If IsArray(v) Then
  s = s & "[" & CStr(LBound(v)) & "," & CStr(UBound(v)) & "]"
  For i = LBound(v) To UBound(v)
   s = s & "{" & CStr(VarType(v(i))) & ":" & CStr(v(i)) & "}"

 TypedValues = s
End Function
Public Function GroupProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal n As Long, ByVal embedded As Boolean, ByVal mode As Long, ByVal choice As Variant) As String
 Dim target As Object, item As Object, group As Object
 Dim values As Variant, labels As Variant, i As Long, stage As String, result As String
 On Error GoTo Failed
 stage = "target"
 If embedded Then
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160).Chart
 Else
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
 End If
 target.ChartType = kind
 If n > 0 Then
  Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
  ReDim values(0 To n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
   values(i) = i + 1
  Next
  item.Values = values
 End If
 stage = "group"
 Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
 stage = "assignment"
 Select Case mode
 Case 1
  ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
   labels(i) = (i + 1) * 10
  Next
  item.XValues = labels
 Case 2
  group.SplitType = choice
 Case 3
  group.SplitValue = choice
 Case 4
  item.Points(1).SecondaryPlot = choice
 Case 5
  item.Points(n).SecondaryPlot = choice
 Case 6
  item.Points(n + 1).SecondaryPlot = choice
 End Select
 result = "ok"
ReadState:
 On Error GoTo FailedRead
 result = result & "|count=" & CStr(target.ChartGroups.Count) & "|group=" & TypeName(group)
 result = result & "|split=" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitType)) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitType)
 result = result & ":" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitValue)) & ":" & TypeName(group.SplitValue) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
 result = result & "|size=" & CStr(group.SecondPlotSize)
 If n > 0 Then
  result = result & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count) & "|item=" & TypeName(item.Points.Item(1))
  result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
  If kind = 68 Or kind = 71 Then
   result = result & "|secondary="
   For i = 1 To item.Points.Count
    result = result & CStr(item.Points(i).SecondaryPlot) & ","
   Next
  End If
 End If
 GroupProbe = result
 Exit Function
Failed:
 result = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
 Resume ReadState
FailedRead:
 GroupProbe = result & "|read-error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "ChartAddContracts"
Option Explicit
Private Function StateOfBook() As String
 Dim i As Long, s As String, sh As Object
 s = CStr(ThisWorkbook.Charts.Count) & ":" & CStr(ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Count) & "|tabs="
 For i = 1 To ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count
  Set sh = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(i)
  s = s & TypeName(sh) & ":" & sh.Name & ";"
 Next
 StateOfBook = s & "|active=" & ActiveSheet.Name
End Function
Public Function ChartAddProbe(ByVal mode As Long, Optional ByVal choice As Variant) As String
 Dim target As Object, first As Object, labels As Variant, values As Variant
 Dim s As String, stage As String, ws As Object, i As Long, item As Object
 On Error GoTo Failed
 stage = "add"
 Select Case mode
 Case 0
  Set first = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
  s = first.Name
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
  s = s & ":" & target.Name
  target.Delete
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
  s = s & ":" & target.Name
 Case 1
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Count:=choice)
 Case 2
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Before:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(1))
 Case 3
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(After:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count))
 Case 4
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Before:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(1), After:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count))
 Case 5
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Type:=choice)
 Case 6
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Add(Type:=choice)
 Case 7
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Before:=ThisWorkbook)
 Case 8
  Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1)
  ws.Activate
  ws.Range("A1").Value2 = "Category"
  ws.Range("B1").Value2 = "Revenue"
  ws.Range("A2").Value2 = "North"
  ws.Range("A3").Value2 = "East"
  ws.Range("A4").Value2 = "West"
  ws.Range("B2").Value2 = 10
  ws.Range("B3").Value2 = 20
  ws.Range("B4").Value2 = 30
  ws.Range("A1:B4").Select
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
 End Select
 stage = "read"
 s = s & "|result=" & TypeName(target) & ":" & target.Name & ":" & CStr(target.Parent Is ThisWorkbook)
 If TypeName(target) = "Chart" Then
  s = s & "|plot=" & CStr(target.ChartType) & "|series=" & CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
  For i = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
   Set item = target.SeriesCollection(i)
   s = s & "|" & item.Name & ":" & item.Formula
  Next
 End If
 ChartAddProbe = "ok|" & s & "|" & StateOfBook()
 Exit Function
Failed:
 ChartAddProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description & "|" & StateOfBook()
End Function

Private Function ArrayText(ByVal v As Variant) As String
 Dim i As Long, s As String
 s = CStr(VarType(v)) & ":" & TypeName(v)
 If IsArray(v) Then
  s = s & "[" & CStr(LBound(v)) & "," & CStr(UBound(v)) & "]"
  For i = LBound(v) To UBound(v)
   s = s & "{" & CStr(VarType(v(i))) & ":" & CStr(v(i)) & "}"

 ElseIf Not IsNull(v) And Not IsError(v) Then

Private Function SeriesMember(ByVal item As Object, ByVal memberName As String) As String
 On Error GoTo Failed
 Select Case memberName
 Case "Name"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.Name)
 Case "Formula"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.Formula)
 Case "Values"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.Values)
 Case "XValues"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.XValues)
 Case "BubbleSizes"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.BubbleSizes)
 Case "Points"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.Points.Count)
 Case Else
  Err.Raise 5
 End Select
 Exit Function
Failed:
 SeriesMember = "error(" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Source & ":" & Err.Description & ")"
End Function
Private Function ChartState(ByVal target As Object) As String
 Dim s As String, item As Object, group As Object, i As Long, j As Long
 s = CStr(target.ChartType) & "|title=" & CStr(target.HasTitle)
 If target.HasTitle Then s = s & ":" & target.ChartTitle.Text
 s = s & "|legend=" & CStr(target.HasLegend)
 If target.HasLegend Then s = s & ":" & CStr(target.Legend.Position)
 s = s & "|groups=" & CStr(target.ChartGroups.Count)
 Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
 s = s & "|split=" & CStr(group.SplitType) & ":" & ArrayText(group.SplitValue)
 s = s & "|size=" & CStr(group.SecondPlotSize)
 s = s & "|series=" & CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
 For i = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
  Set item = target.SeriesCollection(i)
  s = s & "|s=" & SeriesMember(item, "Name") & ":" & SeriesMember(item, "Formula")
  s = s & "|v=" & SeriesMember(item, "Values") & "|x=" & SeriesMember(item, "XValues")
  s = s & "|points=" & SeriesMember(item, "Points")
  If target.ChartType = 68 Or target.ChartType = 71 Then
   s = s & "|secondary="
   For j = 1 To item.Points.Count
    s = s & CStr(item.Points(j).SecondaryPlot) & ","
   Next
  End If
  If target.ChartType = 15 Or target.ChartType = 87 Then s = s & "|sizes=" & SeriesMember(item, "BubbleSizes")
 Next
 ChartState = s
End Function
Public Function BoundaryState() As String
 Dim s As String, sh As Object, c As Object, i As Long, j As Long, row As Long, col As Long
 On Error GoTo Failed
 s = "tabs=" & CStr(ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count)
 For i = 1 To ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count
  Set sh = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(i)
  s = s & "|tab=" & CStr(i) & ":" & TypeName(sh) & ":" & sh.Name
  If TypeName(sh) = "Chart" Then
   s = s & "|" & ChartState(sh)
  Else
   For row = 1 To 4
    For col = 1 To 2
     s = s & "|cell=" & CStr(row) & ":" & CStr(col) & ":" & ArrayText(sh.Cells(row, col).Value2) & ":" & CStr(sh.Cells(row, col).Formula2)
    Next
   Next
   s = s & "|embedded=" & CStr(sh.ChartObjects.Count)
   For j = 1 To sh.ChartObjects.Count
    Set c = sh.ChartObjects(j)
    s = s & "|object=" & c.Name & "|" & ChartState(c.Chart)
   Next
  End If
 Next
 BoundaryState = s
 Exit Function
Failed:
 BoundaryState = s & "|error=" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Source & ":" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal mode As Long, ByVal binding As Long) As Variant
    Dim book As Workbook, group As Object, typedGroup As Windows
    Dim target As Object, item As Object, key As Variant, i As Long
    Dim number As Long, description As String, source As String, helpFile As String, helpContext As Long
    Dim parentIsBook As Boolean, selectedCount As Long, targetIndex As Long
    Dim windowNumber As Double, caption As String, enumerated As Long
    Set book = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    book.Worksheets.Add Count:=2
    For i = 1 To 3
        book.Worksheets(i).Name = "S" & CStr(i)
    Next i
    book.Worksheets(Array("S1", "S2")).Select
    book.Windows(1).Caption = "OxiWindowProbe"
    If binding < 6 Then
        Set group = book.Windows
    Else
        Set group = Application.Windows
    End If
    Set typedGroup = group
    Select Case mode
    Case 0: key = 1
    Case 1: key = 0
    Case 2: key = 2
    Case 3: key = 1.5
    Case 4: key = "1"
    Case 5: key = Null
    Case 6: key = Empty
    Case 7: key = True
    Case 8: key = "OxiWindowProbe"
    Case 9: key = "oxiWINDOWprobe"
    Case 10: key = -1
    Case 11: key = CVErr(2042)
    Case 12: key = Array(1)
    Case 13: Set key = Nothing
    End Select
    book.Saved = True
    On Error Resume Next
    Select Case binding
    Case 0: Set target = book.Windows(key)
    Case 1: Set target = book.Windows.Item(key)
    Case 2: Set target = group(key)
    Case 3: Set target = typedGroup(key)
    Case 4: Set target = CallByName(book, "Windows", VbGet, key)
    Case 5: Set target = CallByName(group, "Item", VbGet, key)
    Case 6: Set target = Application.Windows(key)
    Case 7: Set target = Application.Windows.Item(key)
    End Select
    number = Err.Number
    description = Err.Description
    source = Err.Source
    helpFile = Err.HelpFile
    helpContext = Err.HelpContext
    Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
    selectedCount = -1
    targetIndex = -1
    windowNumber = -1
    If Not target Is Nothing Then
        parentIsBook = target.Parent Is book
        selectedCount = target.SelectedSheets.Count
        targetIndex = target.Index
        windowNumber = target.WindowNumber
        caption = target.Caption
    End If
    For Each item In group
        enumerated = enumerated + 1
    Next item
    Probe = Array(number, description, source, helpFile, helpContext, TypeName(target), target Is Nothing, parentIsBook, selectedCount, targetIndex, windowNumber, caption, TypeName(group), group.Count, VarType(group.Count), Application.Windows.Count, enumerated, book.Saved, VarType(key), ActiveWorkbook Is book)
    book.Close False
End Function

Private Function Describe(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim title As String, position As String
    title = "[off]"
    position = "[off]"
    If target.HasTitle Then title = target.ChartTitle.Text
    If target.HasLegend Then position = CStr(target.Legend.Position)
    Describe = CStr(VarType(target)) & ":" & TypeName(target)
    Describe = Describe & "|title=" & CStr(target.HasTitle) & ":" & title
    Describe = Describe & "|legend=" & CStr(target.HasLegend) & ":" & position
    Describe = Describe & "|type=" & CStr(target.ChartType)
End Function

Public Function AdvancedChartMarker() As String
    AdvancedChartMarker = "oxi-advanced-chart-20261106-v1"

Public Function OfPieProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal splitKind As Long, ByVal splitValue As Double, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object, group As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    If explicitLabels Then
        n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    stage = "group"
    Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
    If splitKind <> 0 Then
        stage = "split-type"
        group.SplitType = splitKind
        stage = "split-value"
        group.SplitValue = splitValue
    End If
    stage = "read"
    OfPieProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|split=" & CStr(group.SplitType) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    OfPieProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function BubbleProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal inputSizes As Variant, ByVal sizesKind As Long, ByVal typeAfterData As Boolean, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    If Not typeAfterData Then target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
    If explicitLabels Then
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    If typeAfterData Then
        stage = "type-after"
        target.ChartType = kind
    End If
    If sizesKind = 1 Then
        stage = "sizes-literal"
        item.BubbleSizes = inputSizes
    ElseIf sizesKind = 2 Then
        stage = "sizes-range"
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            Ledger.Cells(i + 1, 3).Value2 = inputSizes(LBound(inputSizes) + i)
        Next
        item.BubbleSizes = Ledger.Range(Ledger.Cells(1, 3), Ledger.Cells(n, 3))
    End If
    stage = "read"
    BubbleProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|sizes=" & CStr(VarType(item.BubbleSizes)) & ":" & CStr(item.BubbleSizes)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    BubbleProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function StateReport() As String

    On Error GoTo Failed

    report = report & "|embedded=" & CStr(Ledger.ChartObjects.Count)

        report = report & "|bounds=" & CStr(anchor.Left) & ":" & CStr(anchor.Top)
        report = report & ":" & CStr(anchor.Width) & ":" & CStr(anchor.Height)
    Next index
    StateReport = report

End Function

Public Function CaseProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If kind = 0 Then
        CaseProbe = "oxi-uniform-chart-20261106-v2"
        Exit Function
    End If
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    Select Case kind
    Case 1
        ' Observe the original chart or the newly created embedded chart.
    Case 2
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 3
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = "Revenue"
        target.HasLegend = False
    Case 4
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ""
    Case 5
        target.HasTitle = False
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 6
        target.HasTitle = False
    Case 7
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4131
    Case 8
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4107
    Case 9
        target.HasLegend = False
        target.HasLegend = True
    Case 10
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ChrW(&H58F2) & ChrW(&H4E0A) & " & <" & ChrW(&H96C6) & ChrW(&H8A08) & ">" & vbLf & "2026"
    Case 11
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Caption = "Caption"
    Case 12
        target.ChartType = 51
    Case Else
        Err.Raise 5, "UniformChart", "Unknown case"
    End Select
    CaseProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|objects=" & CStr(Ledger.ChartObjects.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    CaseProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Private Function TypedValues(ByVal value As Variant) As String
    Dim index As Long, result As String
    result = CStr(VarType(value)) & ":" & TypeName(value)
    If IsArray(value) Then
        result = result & "[" & CStr(LBound(value)) & "," & CStr(UBound(value)) & "]"
        For index = LBound(value) To UBound(value)
            result = result & "{" & CStr(VarType(value(index))) & ":" & CStr(value(index)) & "}"
        Next index
    Else
        result = result & ":" & CStr(value)
    End If
    TypedValues = result
End Function

Private Function DescribeSeries(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim index As Long, item As Object, result As String
    result = CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
    For index = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection(index)
        result = result & "|series=" & item.Name & ":" & item.Formula
        result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
    Next index
    DescribeSeries = result
End Function

Public Function ChartTypeProbe(ByVal chartType As Long, ByVal sourceKind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = chartType
    If sourceKind = 1 Then
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
        item.Name = "Revenue"
        item.Values = Array(1.25, 2.5, 3.75)
        item.XValues = Array("1", "2", "3")
    ElseIf sourceKind = 2 Then
        Ledger.Range("A1").Value2 = "Category"
        Ledger.Range("B1").Value2 = "Revenue"
        Ledger.Range("A2").Value2 = 1
        Ledger.Range("A3").Value2 = 2
        Ledger.Range("A4").Value2 = 3
        Ledger.Range("B2").Value2 = 1.25
        Ledger.Range("B3").Value2 = 2.5
        Ledger.Range("B4").Value2 = 3.75
        target.SetSourceData Ledger.Range("A1:B4")
    End If
    ChartTypeProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    ChartTypeProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Private Function TypedValues(ByVal v As Variant) As String
 Dim i As Long, s As String

 If IsArray(v) Then
  s = s & "[" & CStr(LBound(v)) & "," & CStr(UBound(v)) & "]"
  For i = LBound(v) To UBound(v)
   s = s & "{" & CStr(VarType(v(i))) & ":" & CStr(v(i)) & "}"
  Next

End Function
Public Function GroupProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal n As Long, ByVal embedded As Boolean, ByVal mode As Long, ByVal choice As Variant) As String
 Dim target As Object, item As Object, group As Object
 Dim values As Variant, labels As Variant, i As Long, stage As String, result As String
 On Error GoTo Failed
 stage = "target"
 If embedded Then
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160).Chart
 Else
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
 End If
 target.ChartType = kind
 If n > 0 Then
  Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
  ReDim values(0 To n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
   values(i) = i + 1
  Next
  item.Values = values
 End If
 stage = "group"
 Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
 stage = "assignment"
 Select Case mode
 Case 1
  ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
   labels(i) = (i + 1) * 10
  Next
  item.XValues = labels
 Case 2
  group.SplitType = choice
 Case 3
  group.SplitValue = choice
 Case 4
  item.Points(1).SecondaryPlot = choice
 Case 5
  item.Points(n).SecondaryPlot = choice
 Case 6
  item.Points(n + 1).SecondaryPlot = choice
 End Select
 result = "ok"
ReadState:
 On Error GoTo FailedRead
 result = result & "|count=" & CStr(target.ChartGroups.Count) & "|group=" & TypeName(group)
 result = result & "|split=" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitType)) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitType)
 result = result & ":" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitValue)) & ":" & TypeName(group.SplitValue) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
 result = result & "|size=" & CStr(group.SecondPlotSize)
 If n > 0 Then
  result = result & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count) & "|item=" & TypeName(item.Points.Item(1))
  result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
  If kind = 68 Or kind = 71 Then
   result = result & "|secondary="
   For i = 1 To item.Points.Count
    result = result & CStr(item.Points(i).SecondaryPlot) & ","
   Next
  End If
 End If
 GroupProbe = result
 Exit Function
Failed:
 result = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
 Resume ReadState
FailedRead:
 GroupProbe = result & "|read-error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Private Function StateOfBook() As String

Public Function ChartAddProbe(ByVal mode As Long, Optional ByVal choice As Variant) As String
 Dim target As Object, first As Object, labels As Variant, values As Variant
 Dim s As String, stage As String, ws As Object, i As Long, item As Object
 On Error GoTo Failed
 stage = "add"
 Select Case mode
 Case 0
  Set first = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
  s = first.Name
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
  s = s & ":" & target.Name
  target.Delete
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
  s = s & ":" & target.Name
 Case 1
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Count:=choice)
 Case 2
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Before:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(1))
 Case 3
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(After:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count))
 Case 4
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Before:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(1), After:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count))
 Case 5
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Type:=choice)
 Case 6
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Add(Type:=choice)
 Case 7
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Before:=ThisWorkbook)
 Case 8
  Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1)
  ws.Activate
  ws.Range("A1").Value2 = "Category"
  ws.Range("B1").Value2 = "Revenue"
  ws.Range("A2").Value2 = "North"
  ws.Range("A3").Value2 = "East"
  ws.Range("A4").Value2 = "West"
  ws.Range("B2").Value2 = 10
  ws.Range("B3").Value2 = 20
  ws.Range("B4").Value2 = 30
  ws.Range("A1:B4").Select
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
 End Select
 stage = "read"
 s = s & "|result=" & TypeName(target) & ":" & target.Name & ":" & CStr(target.Parent Is ThisWorkbook)
 If TypeName(target) = "Chart" Then
  s = s & "|plot=" & CStr(target.ChartType) & "|series=" & CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
  For i = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
   Set item = target.SeriesCollection(i)
   s = s & "|" & item.Name & ":" & item.Formula
  Next
 End If
 ChartAddProbe = "ok|" & s & "|" & StateOfBook()
 Exit Function
Failed:
 ChartAddProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description & "|" & StateOfBook()
End Function

Private Function ArrayText(ByVal v As Variant) As String

Private Function SeriesMember(ByVal item As Object, ByVal memberName As String) As String
 On Error GoTo Failed

 Case "Formula"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.Formula)

Private Function ChartState(ByVal target As Object) As String
 Dim s As String, item As Object, group As Object, i As Long, j As Long
 s = CStr(target.ChartType) & "|title=" & CStr(target.HasTitle)
 If target.HasTitle Then s = s & ":" & target.ChartTitle.Text
 s = s & "|legend=" & CStr(target.HasLegend)
 If target.HasLegend Then s = s & ":" & CStr(target.Legend.Position)
 s = s & "|groups=" & CStr(target.ChartGroups.Count)
 Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
 s = s & "|split=" & CStr(group.SplitType) & ":" & ArrayText(group.SplitValue)
 s = s & "|size=" & CStr(group.SecondPlotSize)
 s = s & "|series=" & CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
 For i = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
  Set item = target.SeriesCollection(i)
  s = s & "|s=" & SeriesMember(item, "Name") & ":" & SeriesMember(item, "Formula")
  s = s & "|v=" & SeriesMember(item, "Values") & "|x=" & SeriesMember(item, "XValues")
  s = s & "|points=" & SeriesMember(item, "Points")
  If target.ChartType = 68 Or target.ChartType = 71 Then
   s = s & "|secondary="
   For j = 1 To item.Points.Count
    s = s & CStr(item.Points(j).SecondaryPlot) & ","
   Next
  End If
  If target.ChartType = 15 Or target.ChartType = 87 Then s = s & "|sizes=" & SeriesMember(item, "BubbleSizes")
 Next
 ChartState = s
End Function
Public Function BoundaryState() As String
 Dim s As String, sh As Object, c As Object, i As Long, j As Long, row As Long, col As Long
 On Error GoTo Failed
 s = "tabs=" & CStr(ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count)

    Next
   Next
   s = s & "|embedded=" & CStr(sh.ChartObjects.Count)
   For j = 1 To sh.ChartObjects.Count
    Set c = sh.ChartObjects(j)
    s = s & "|object=" & c.Name & "|" & ChartState(c.Chart)
   Next
  End If
 Next
 BoundaryState = s
 Exit Function
Failed:
 BoundaryState = s & "|error=" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Source & ":" & Err.Description
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "WindowLifecycleOracle"

' Self-authored conformance probe, CC BY-SA 4.0.
Public Function Probe(ByVal mode As Long, ByVal binding As Long) As Variant
    Dim book As Workbook, otherBook As Workbook, group As Object
    Dim first As Window, second As Window, third As Window, target As Object, item As Object
    Dim i As Long, enumeration As String, number As Long, description As String, source As String
    Dim helpFile As String, helpContext As Long, selectedCount As Long, targetIndex As Long
    Dim indexNumber As Long, indexDescription As String, indexSource As String
    Dim indexHelpFile As String, indexHelpContext As Long
    Dim windowNumber As Double, caption As String, activeSheetName As String
    Dim activeCellAddress As String, zoom As Double, parentIsBook As Boolean
    Set book = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    book.Worksheets.Add Count:=2
    For i = 1 To 3
        book.Worksheets(i).Name = "S" & CStr(i)
    Next i
    Set first = book.Windows(1)
    Set group = book.Windows
    book.Worksheets(Array("S1", "S2")).Select
    book.Worksheets(1).Range("B2").Select
    first.Zoom = 90
    If mode <> 0 Then
        Set second = book.NewWindow
        book.Worksheets(3).Select
        book.Worksheets(3).Range("C3").Select
        second.Zoom = 120
    End If
    If mode = 2 Or mode = 5 Then
        Set third = book.NewWindow
        book.Worksheets(1).Select
        book.Worksheets(1).Range("D4").Select
        third.Zoom = 150
    End If
    first.Caption = "W1"
    If Not second Is Nothing Then second.Caption = "W2"
    If Not third Is Nothing Then third.Caption = "W3"
    If mode = 3 Then first.Activate
    If mode = 4 Or mode = 5 Then second.Close SaveChanges:=False
    If mode = 6 Then
        Set otherBook = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
        otherBook.Saved = True
    End If
    If mode = 7 Then ThisWorkbook.Activate
    book.Saved = True
    On Error Resume Next
    Select Case binding
    Case 0: Set target = book.Windows(1)
    Case 1: Set target = book.Windows.Item(2)
    Case 2: Set target = book.Windows(3)
    Case 3: Set target = group("W1")
    Case 4: Set target = group("W2")
    Case 5: Set target = group("W3")
    Case 6: Set target = Application.Windows("W1")
    Case 7: Set target = first
    End Select
    number = Err.Number
    description = Err.Description
    source = Err.Source
    helpFile = Err.HelpFile
    helpContext = Err.HelpContext
    Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
    selectedCount = -1
    targetIndex = -1
    windowNumber = -1
    zoom = -1
    If Not target Is Nothing Then
        parentIsBook = target.Parent Is book
        selectedCount = target.SelectedSheets.Count
        On Error Resume Next
        targetIndex = target.Index
        indexNumber = Err.Number
        indexDescription = Err.Description
        indexSource = Err.Source
        indexHelpFile = Err.HelpFile
        indexHelpContext = Err.HelpContext

Public Function BubbleProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal inputSizes As Variant, ByVal sizesKind As Long, ByVal typeAfterData As Boolean, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String

    item.Values = inputValues

Public Function CaseProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String

    Else
        Set target = PlotHost

    Select Case kind

    Case 2
        target.HasTitle = True

        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = "Revenue"
        target.HasLegend = False
    Case 4
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ""
    Case 5
        target.HasTitle = False
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 6
        target.HasTitle = False
    Case 7
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4131
    Case 8
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4107
    Case 9
        target.HasLegend = False
        target.HasLegend = True
    Case 10
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ChrW(&H58F2) & ChrW(&H4E0A) & " & <" & ChrW(&H96C6) & ChrW(&H8A08) & ">" & vbLf & "2026"

Public Function GroupProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal n As Long, ByVal embedded As Boolean, ByVal mode As Long, ByVal choice As Variant) As String

 End If

   values(i) = i + 1

 result = result & "|split=" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitType)) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitType)

Public Function Probe(ByVal mode As Long, ByVal binding As Long) As Variant
    Dim book As Workbook, first As Window, second As Window, third As Window, receiver As Object, item As Window
    Dim beforeFirst As String, beforeSecond As String, enumeration As String, i As Long
    Dim number As Long, description As String, source As String, helpFile As String, helpContext As Long
    Dim parentIsBook As Boolean
    Set book = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    book.Worksheets.Add Count:=2
    For i = 1 To 3
        book.Worksheets(i).Name = "S" & CStr(i)
    Next i
    Set first = book.Windows(1)
    book.Worksheets(Array("S1", "S2")).Select
    book.Worksheets(1).Range("B2").Select
    first.Zoom = 90
    Set second = book.NewWindow
    book.Worksheets(3).Select
    book.Worksheets(3).Range("C3").Select
    second.Zoom = 120
    first.Caption = "W1"
    second.Caption = "W2"
    If mode = 4 Or mode = 5 Then first.Activate
    If mode = 6 Or mode = 7 Then book.Activate
    beforeFirst = State(first)
    beforeSecond = State(second)
    If mode = 0 Or mode = 6 Then
        Set receiver = book
    ElseIf mode = 1 Or mode = 4 Then
        Set receiver = first
    ElseIf mode = 3 Then
        Set receiver = Application.ActiveWindow
    Else
        Set receiver = second
    End If
    On Error Resume Next
    If binding = 0 Then
        If mode = 0 Or mode = 6 Then
            Set third = book.NewWindow
        ElseIf mode = 1 Or mode = 4 Then
            Set third = first.NewWindow
        ElseIf mode = 3 Then
            Set third = Application.ActiveWindow.NewWindow
        Else
            Set third = second.NewWindow

    ElseIf binding = 1 Then
        Set third = CallByName(receiver, "NewWindow", VbMethod)

    End If
    number = Err.Number
    description = Err.Description
    source = Err.Source
    helpFile = Err.HelpFile
    helpContext = Err.HelpContext
    Err.Clear
    If Not third Is Nothing Then
        third.Caption = "W3"
        parentIsBook = third.Parent Is book
    End If
    For Each item In book.Windows
        enumeration = enumeration & "|" & State(item)
    Next item
    book.Saved = True
    Probe = Array(number, description, source, helpFile, helpContext, TypeName(third), third Is Nothing, parentIsBook, beforeFirst, beforeSecond, State(first), State(second), State(third), State(Application.ActiveWindow), book.Windows.Count, Application.Windows.Count, enumeration, book.Saved)

    Case 8

Private Function DescribeSeries(ByVal target As Object) As String

  s = s & "|v=" & SeriesMember(item, "Values") & "|x=" & SeriesMember(item, "XValues")

Private Function Describe(ByVal target As Object) As String

    position = "[off]"

    If target.HasLegend Then position = CStr(target.Legend.Position)
    Describe = CStr(VarType(target)) & ":" & TypeName(target)
    Describe = Describe & "|title=" & CStr(target.HasTitle) & ":" & title

Public Function OfPieProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal splitKind As Long, ByVal splitValue As Double, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object, group As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    If explicitLabels Then
        n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    stage = "group"
    Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
    If splitKind <> 0 Then
        stage = "split-type"
        group.SplitType = splitKind
        stage = "split-value"
        group.SplitValue = splitValue
    End If
    stage = "read"
    OfPieProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|split=" & CStr(group.SplitType) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    OfPieProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function BubbleProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal inputSizes As Variant, ByVal sizesKind As Long, ByVal typeAfterData As Boolean, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    If Not typeAfterData Then target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
    If explicitLabels Then
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    If typeAfterData Then
        stage = "type-after"
        target.ChartType = kind
    End If
    If sizesKind = 1 Then
        stage = "sizes-literal"
        item.BubbleSizes = inputSizes
    ElseIf sizesKind = 2 Then
        stage = "sizes-range"
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            Ledger.Cells(i + 1, 3).Value2 = inputSizes(LBound(inputSizes) + i)
        Next
        item.BubbleSizes = Ledger.Range(Ledger.Cells(1, 3), Ledger.Cells(n, 3))
    End If
    stage = "read"
    BubbleProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|sizes=" & CStr(VarType(item.BubbleSizes)) & ":" & CStr(item.BubbleSizes)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function

    BubbleProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description

Public Function CaseProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If kind = 0 Then
        CaseProbe = "oxi-uniform-chart-20261106-v2"
        Exit Function
    End If
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    Select Case kind
    Case 1
        ' Observe the original chart or the newly created embedded chart.
    Case 2
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 3
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = "Revenue"
        target.HasLegend = False
    Case 4
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ""
    Case 5
        target.HasTitle = False
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 6
        target.HasTitle = False
    Case 7
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4131
    Case 8
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4107
    Case 9
        target.HasLegend = False
        target.HasLegend = True
    Case 10
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ChrW(&H58F2) & ChrW(&H4E0A) & " & <" & ChrW(&H96C6) & ChrW(&H8A08) & ">" & vbLf & "2026"
    Case 11
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Caption = "Caption"
    Case 12
        target.ChartType = 51
    Case Else
        Err.Raise 5, "UniformChart", "Unknown case"
    End Select
    CaseProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|objects=" & CStr(Ledger.ChartObjects.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    CaseProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Private Function TypedValues(ByVal value As Variant) As String
    Dim index As Long, result As String
    result = CStr(VarType(value)) & ":" & TypeName(value)
    If IsArray(value) Then
        result = result & "[" & CStr(LBound(value)) & "," & CStr(UBound(value)) & "]"
        For index = LBound(value) To UBound(value)
            result = result & "{" & CStr(VarType(value(index))) & ":" & CStr(value(index)) & "}"
        Next index
    Else
        result = result & ":" & CStr(value)
    End If
    TypedValues = result
End Function

Private Function DescribeSeries(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim index As Long, item As Object, result As String
    result = CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
    For index = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection(index)
        result = result & "|series=" & item.Name & ":" & item.Formula
        result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
    Next index
    DescribeSeries = result
End Function

Public Function ChartTypeProbe(ByVal chartType As Long, ByVal sourceKind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String

    Else

        Ledger.Range("A2").Value2 = 1
        Ledger.Range("A3").Value2 = 2
        Ledger.Range("A4").Value2 = 3
        Ledger.Range("B2").Value2 = 1.25
        Ledger.Range("B3").Value2 = 2.5
        Ledger.Range("B4").Value2 = 3.75
        target.SetSourceData Ledger.Range("A1:B4")
    End If
    ChartTypeProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    ChartTypeProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function GroupProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal n As Long, ByVal embedded As Boolean, ByVal mode As Long, ByVal choice As Variant) As String
 Dim target As Object, item As Object, group As Object
 Dim values As Variant, labels As Variant, i As Long, stage As String, result As String
 On Error GoTo Failed
 stage = "target"
 If embedded Then
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160).Chart
 Else
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
 End If
 target.ChartType = kind
 If n > 0 Then
  Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
  ReDim values(0 To n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
   values(i) = i + 1
  Next
  item.Values = values
 End If
 stage = "group"
 Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
 stage = "assignment"
 Select Case mode
 Case 1
  ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
   labels(i) = (i + 1) * 10
  Next
  item.XValues = labels
 Case 2
  group.SplitType = choice
 Case 3
  group.SplitValue = choice
 Case 4
  item.Points(1).SecondaryPlot = choice
 Case 5
  item.Points(n).SecondaryPlot = choice
 Case 6
  item.Points(n + 1).SecondaryPlot = choice
 End Select
 result = "ok"
ReadState:
 On Error GoTo FailedRead
 result = result & "|count=" & CStr(target.ChartGroups.Count) & "|group=" & TypeName(group)
 result = result & "|split=" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitType)) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitType)
 result = result & ":" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitValue)) & ":" & TypeName(group.SplitValue) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
 result = result & "|size=" & CStr(group.SecondPlotSize)
 If n > 0 Then
  result = result & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count) & "|item=" & TypeName(item.Points.Item(1))
  result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
  If kind = 68 Or kind = 71 Then
   result = result & "|secondary="
   For i = 1 To item.Points.Count
    result = result & CStr(item.Points(i).SecondaryPlot) & ","
   Next
  End If
 End If
 GroupProbe = result
 Exit Function
Failed:
 result = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
 Resume ReadState
FailedRead:
 GroupProbe = result & "|read-error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function ChartAddProbe(ByVal mode As Long, Optional ByVal choice As Variant) As String
 Dim target As Object, first As Object, labels As Variant, values As Variant
 Dim s As String, stage As String, ws As Object, i As Long, item As Object
 On Error GoTo Failed
 stage = "add"
 Select Case mode
 Case 0
  Set first = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
  s = first.Name
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
  s = s & ":" & target.Name
  target.Delete
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add

 Case 1

 Case 2

 Case 3
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(After:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count))

 Case 5
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Type:=choice)
 Case 6
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Add(Type:=choice)
 Case 7
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Before:=ThisWorkbook)
 Case 8
  Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1)
  ws.Activate
  ws.Range("A1").Value2 = "Category"
  ws.Range("B1").Value2 = "Revenue"
  ws.Range("A2").Value2 = "North"
  ws.Range("A3").Value2 = "East"

  ws.Range("A1:B4").Select
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
 End Select
 stage = "read"
 s = s & "|result=" & TypeName(target) & ":" & target.Name & ":" & CStr(target.Parent Is ThisWorkbook)
 If TypeName(target) = "Chart" Then
  s = s & "|plot=" & CStr(target.ChartType) & "|series=" & CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
  For i = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
   Set item = target.SeriesCollection(i)
   s = s & "|" & item.Name & ":" & item.Formula

Private Function ChartState(ByVal target As Object) As String

 s = s & "|size=" & CStr(group.SecondPlotSize)
 s = s & "|series=" & CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
 For i = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
  Set item = target.SeriesCollection(i)
  s = s & "|s=" & SeriesMember(item, "Name") & ":" & SeriesMember(item, "Formula")
  s = s & "|v=" & SeriesMember(item, "Values") & "|x=" & SeriesMember(item, "XValues")
  s = s & "|points=" & SeriesMember(item, "Points")
  If target.ChartType = 68 Or target.ChartType = 71 Then
   s = s & "|secondary="
   For j = 1 To item.Points.Count
    s = s & CStr(item.Points(j).SecondaryPlot) & ","
   Next

  If target.ChartType = 15 Or target.ChartType = 87 Then s = s & "|sizes=" & SeriesMember(item, "BubbleSizes")

Public Function BoundaryState() As String

Public Function Probe(ByVal mode As Long, ByVal binding As Long) As Variant
    Dim book As Workbook, first As Window, second As Window, third As Window, receiver As Object, item As Window
    Dim i As Long
    Set book = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    book.Worksheets.Add Count:=2
    For i = 1 To 3
        book.Worksheets(i).Name = "S" & CStr(i)
    Next i
    Set first = book.Windows(1)
    book.Worksheets(Array("S1", "S2")).Select
    book.Worksheets(1).Range("B2").Select
    first.Zoom = 90
    Set second = book.NewWindow
    book.Worksheets(3).Select
    book.Worksheets(3).Range("C3").Select
    second.Zoom = 120
    first.Caption = "W1"
    second.Caption = "W2"
    Dim target As Window, activation As Window, stateValue As Variant
    Dim beforeFirst As String, beforeSecond As String, setFirst As String, setSecond As String
    Dim sn As Long, sd As String, ss As String, sh As String, sc As Long
    Dim an As Long, ad As String, ac As String, ah As String, ax As Long
    Set target = second
    Set activation = first
    stateValue = -4143
    Select Case mode
        Case 0: Set target = first
        Case 1: Set target = second
        Case 2: stateValue = -4140
        Case 3: Set target = first: stateValue = -4137: Set activation = second
        Case 4: Set target = first: stateValue = -4140
        Case 5: stateValue = "bad"
        Case 6: stateValue = 0
        Case 7: stateValue = Null
    End Select
    beforeFirst = State(first)
    beforeSecond = State(second)
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    If binding = 0 Then
        target.WindowState = stateValue
    ElseIf binding = 1 Then
        CallByName target, "WindowState", VbLet, stateValue
    Else
        CallByName target, "WindowState", VbSet, stateValue
    End If
    sn = Err.Number: sd = Err.Description: ss = Err.Source: sh = Err.HelpFile: sc = Err.HelpContext
    Err.Clear
    setFirst = State(first)
    setSecond = State(second)
    Err.Clear
    activation.Activate
    an = Err.Number: ad = Err.Description: ac = Err.Source: ah = Err.HelpFile: ax = Err.HelpContext
    Err.Clear
    book.Saved = True
    Probe = Array(sn, sd, ss, sh, sc, an, ad, ac, ah, ax, beforeFirst, beforeSecond, setFirst, setSecond, State(first), State(second), State(Application.ActiveWindow), book.Windows.Count, Application.Windows.Count, book.Saved)

End Function

Option Explicit

Private Function Describe(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim title As String, position As String
    title = "[off]"
    position = "[off]"
    If target.HasTitle Then title = target.ChartTitle.Text
    If target.HasLegend Then position = CStr(target.Legend.Position)
    Describe = CStr(VarType(target)) & ":" & TypeName(target)
    Describe = Describe & "|title=" & CStr(target.HasTitle) & ":" & title
    Describe = Describe & "|legend=" & CStr(target.HasLegend) & ":" & position
    Describe = Describe & "|type=" & CStr(target.ChartType)
End Function


' Self-authored conformance probes, CC BY-SA 4.0.
Public Function AdvancedChartMarker() As String
    AdvancedChartMarker = "oxi-advanced-chart-20261106-v1"
End Function

Public Function OfPieProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal splitKind As Long, ByVal splitValue As Double, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object, group As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    If explicitLabels Then
        n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    stage = "group"
    Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
    If splitKind <> 0 Then
        stage = "split-type"
        group.SplitType = splitKind
        stage = "split-value"
        group.SplitValue = splitValue
    End If
    stage = "read"
    OfPieProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|split=" & CStr(group.SplitType) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    OfPieProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function BubbleProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal inputSizes As Variant, ByVal sizesKind As Long, ByVal typeAfterData As Boolean, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    If Not typeAfterData Then target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
    If explicitLabels Then
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    If typeAfterData Then
        stage = "type-after"
        target.ChartType = kind
    End If
    If sizesKind = 1 Then
        stage = "sizes-literal"
        item.BubbleSizes = inputSizes
    ElseIf sizesKind = 2 Then
        stage = "sizes-range"
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            Ledger.Cells(i + 1, 3).Value2 = inputSizes(LBound(inputSizes) + i)
        Next
        item.BubbleSizes = Ledger.Range(Ledger.Cells(1, 3), Ledger.Cells(n, 3))
    End If
    stage = "read"
    BubbleProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|sizes=" & CStr(VarType(item.BubbleSizes)) & ":" & CStr(item.BubbleSizes)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    BubbleProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function StateReport() As String
    Dim index As Long, anchor As Object, report As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    report = "sheet=" & Describe(PlotHost) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(PlotHost)
    report = report & "|embedded=" & CStr(Ledger.ChartObjects.Count)
    For index = 1 To Ledger.ChartObjects.Count
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects(index)
        report = report & "|object=" & anchor.Name & ":" & Describe(anchor.Chart) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(anchor.Chart)
        report = report & "|bounds=" & CStr(anchor.Left) & ":" & CStr(anchor.Top)
        report = report & ":" & CStr(anchor.Width) & ":" & CStr(anchor.Height)
    Next index
    StateReport = report
    Exit Function
Failed:
    StateReport = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function CaseProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If kind = 0 Then
        CaseProbe = "oxi-uniform-chart-20261106-v2"
        Exit Function
    End If
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    Select Case kind
    Case 1
        ' Observe the original chart or the newly created embedded chart.
    Case 2
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 3
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = "Revenue"
        target.HasLegend = False
    Case 4
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ""
    Case 5
        target.HasTitle = False
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 6
        target.HasTitle = False
    Case 7
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4131
    Case 8
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4107
    Case 9
        target.HasLegend = False
        target.HasLegend = True
    Case 10
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ChrW(&H58F2) & ChrW(&H4E0A) & " & <" & ChrW(&H96C6) & ChrW(&H8A08) & ">" & vbLf & "2026"
    Case 11
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Caption = "Caption"
    Case 12
        target.ChartType = 51
    Case Else
        Err.Raise 5, "UniformChart", "Unknown case"
    End Select
    CaseProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|objects=" & CStr(Ledger.ChartObjects.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    CaseProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Private Function TypedValues(ByVal value As Variant) As String
    Dim index As Long, result As String
    result = CStr(VarType(value)) & ":" & TypeName(value)
    If IsArray(value) Then
        result = result & "[" & CStr(LBound(value)) & "," & CStr(UBound(value)) & "]"
        For index = LBound(value) To UBound(value)
            result = result & "{" & CStr(VarType(value(index))) & ":" & CStr(value(index)) & "}"
        Next index
    Else
        result = result & ":" & CStr(value)
    End If
    TypedValues = result
End Function

Private Function DescribeSeries(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim index As Long, item As Object, result As String
    result = CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
    For index = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection(index)
        result = result & "|series=" & item.Name & ":" & item.Formula
        result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
    Next index
    DescribeSeries = result
End Function

Public Function ChartTypeProbe(ByVal chartType As Long, ByVal sourceKind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = chartType
    If sourceKind = 1 Then
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
        item.Name = "Revenue"
        item.Values = Array(1.25, 2.5, 3.75)
        item.XValues = Array("1", "2", "3")
    ElseIf sourceKind = 2 Then
        Ledger.Range("A1").Value2 = "Category"
        Ledger.Range("B1").Value2 = "Revenue"
        Ledger.Range("A2").Value2 = 1
        Ledger.Range("A3").Value2 = 2
        Ledger.Range("A4").Value2 = 3
        Ledger.Range("B2").Value2 = 1.25
        Ledger.Range("B3").Value2 = 2.5
        Ledger.Range("B4").Value2 = 3.75
        target.SetSourceData Ledger.Range("A1:B4")
    End If
    ChartTypeProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    ChartTypeProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "GroupContractProbe"
Option Explicit
Private Function TypedValues(ByVal v As Variant) As String
 Dim i As Long, s As String
 s = CStr(VarType(v)) & ":" & TypeName(v)
 If IsArray(v) Then
  s = s & "[" & CStr(LBound(v)) & "," & CStr(UBound(v)) & "]"
  For i = LBound(v) To UBound(v)
   s = s & "{" & CStr(VarType(v(i))) & ":" & CStr(v(i)) & "}"
  Next
 End If
 TypedValues = s
End Function
Public Function GroupProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal n As Long, ByVal embedded As Boolean, ByVal mode As Long, ByVal choice As Variant) As String
 Dim target As Object, item As Object, group As Object
 Dim values As Variant, labels As Variant, i As Long, stage As String, result As String
 On Error GoTo Failed
 stage = "target"
 If embedded Then
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160).Chart
 Else
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
 End If
 target.ChartType = kind
 If n > 0 Then
  Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
  ReDim values(0 To n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
   values(i) = i + 1
  Next
  item.Values = values
 End If
 stage = "group"
 Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
 stage = "assignment"
 Select Case mode
 Case 1
  ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
   labels(i) = (i + 1) * 10
  Next
  item.XValues = labels
 Case 2
  group.SplitType = choice
 Case 3
  group.SplitValue = choice
 Case 4
  item.Points(1).SecondaryPlot = choice
 Case 5
  item.Points(n).SecondaryPlot = choice
 Case 6
  item.Points(n + 1).SecondaryPlot = choice
 End Select
 result = "ok"
ReadState:
 On Error GoTo FailedRead
 result = result & "|count=" & CStr(target.ChartGroups.Count) & "|group=" & TypeName(group)
 result = result & "|split=" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitType)) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitType)
 result = result & ":" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitValue)) & ":" & TypeName(group.SplitValue) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
 result = result & "|size=" & CStr(group.SecondPlotSize)
 If n > 0 Then
  result = result & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count) & "|item=" & TypeName(item.Points.Item(1))
  result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
  If kind = 68 Or kind = 71 Then
   result = result & "|secondary="
   For i = 1 To item.Points.Count
    result = result & CStr(item.Points(i).SecondaryPlot) & ","
   Next
  End If
 End If
 GroupProbe = result
 Exit Function
Failed:
 result = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
 Resume ReadState
FailedRead:
 GroupProbe = result & "|read-error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "ChartAddContracts"
Option Explicit
Private Function StateOfBook() As String
 Dim i As Long, s As String, sh As Object
 s = CStr(ThisWorkbook.Charts.Count) & ":" & CStr(ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Count) & "|tabs="
 For i = 1 To ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count
  Set sh = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(i)
  s = s & TypeName(sh) & ":" & sh.Name & ";"
 Next
 StateOfBook = s & "|active=" & ActiveSheet.Name
End Function
Public Function ChartAddProbe(ByVal mode As Long, Optional ByVal choice As Variant) As String
 Dim target As Object, first As Object, labels As Variant, values As Variant
 Dim s As String, stage As String, ws As Object, i As Long, item As Object
 On Error GoTo Failed
 stage = "add"
 Select Case mode
 Case 0
  Set first = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
  s = first.Name
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
  s = s & ":" & target.Name
  target.Delete
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
  s = s & ":" & target.Name
 Case 1
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Count:=choice)
 Case 2
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Before:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(1))
 Case 3
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(After:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count))
 Case 4
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Before:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(1), After:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count))
 Case 5
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Type:=choice)
 Case 6
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Add(Type:=choice)
 Case 7
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Before:=ThisWorkbook)
 Case 8
  Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1)
  ws.Activate
  ws.Range("A1").Value2 = "Category"

Attribute VB_Name = "BoundaryInspection"
Option Explicit
Private Function ArrayText(ByVal v As Variant) As String
 Dim i As Long, s As String
 s = CStr(VarType(v)) & ":" & TypeName(v)
 If IsArray(v) Then
  s = s & "[" & CStr(LBound(v)) & "," & CStr(UBound(v)) & "]"
  For i = LBound(v) To UBound(v)
   s = s & "{" & CStr(VarType(v(i))) & ":" & CStr(v(i)) & "}"
  Next
 ElseIf Not IsNull(v) And Not IsError(v) Then
  s = s & "{" & CStr(v) & "}"
 End If
 ArrayText = s
End Function
Private Function SeriesMember(ByVal item As Object, ByVal memberName As String) As String
 On Error GoTo Failed
 Select Case memberName
 Case "Name"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.Name)
 Case "Formula"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.Formula)
 Case "Values"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.Values)
 Case "XValues"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.XValues)
 Case "BubbleSizes"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.BubbleSizes)
 Case "Points"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.Points.Count)
 Case Else
  Err.Raise 5
 End Select
 Exit Function
Failed:
 SeriesMember = "error(" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Source & ":" & Err.Description & ")"
End Function
Private Function ChartState(ByVal target As Object) As String
 Dim s As String, item As Object, group As Object, i As Long, j As Long
 s = CStr(target.ChartType) & "|title=" & CStr(target.HasTitle)
 If target.HasTitle Then s = s & ":" & target.ChartTitle.Text
 s = s & "|legend=" & CStr(target.HasLegend)
 If target.HasLegend Then s = s & ":" & CStr(target.Legend.Position)
 s = s & "|groups=" & CStr(target.ChartGroups.Count)
 Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
 s = s & "|split=" & CStr(group.SplitType) & ":" & ArrayText(group.SplitValue)
 s = s & "|size=" & CStr(group.SecondPlotSize)
 s = s & "|series=" & CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
 For i = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
  Set item = target.SeriesCollection(i)
  s = s & "|s=" & SeriesMember(item, "Name") & ":" & SeriesMember(item, "Formula")
  s = s & "|v=" & SeriesMember(item, "Values") & "|x=" & SeriesMember(item, "XValues")
  s = s & "|points=" & SeriesMember(item, "Points")
  If target.ChartType = 68 Or target.ChartType = 71 Then
   s = s & "|secondary="
   For j = 1 To item.Points.Count
    s = s & CStr(item.Points(j).SecondaryPlot) & ","
   Next
  End If
  If target.ChartType = 15 Or target.ChartType = 87 Then s = s & "|sizes=" & SeriesMember(item, "BubbleSizes")
 Next
 ChartState = s
End Function
Public Function BoundaryState() As String
 Dim s As String, sh As Object, c As Object, i As Long, j As Long, row As Long, col As Long
 On Error GoTo Failed
 s = "tabs=" & CStr(ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count)
 For i = 1 To ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count
  Set sh = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(i)
  s = s & "|tab=" & CStr(i) & ":" & TypeName(sh) & ":" & sh.Name
  If TypeName(sh) = "Chart" Then
   s = s & "|" & ChartState(sh)
  Else
   For row = 1 To 4
    For col = 1 To 2
     s = s & "|cell=" & CStr(row) & ":" & CStr(col) & ":" & ArrayText(sh.Cells(row, col).Value2) & ":" & CStr(sh.Cells(row, col).Formula2)
    Next
   Next
   s = s & "|embedded=" & CStr(sh.ChartObjects.Count)
   For j = 1 To sh.ChartObjects.Count
    Set c = sh.ChartObjects(j)
    s = s & "|object=" & c.Name & "|" & ChartState(c.Chart)
   Next
  End If
 Next

 Exit Function

End Function

Private Function State(ByVal target As Window) As String

    Dim book As Workbook, first As Window, second As Window, third As Window, receiver As Object, item As Window

    Set book = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)

    Next i
    Set first = book.Windows(1)
    book.Worksheets(Array("S1", "S2")).Select
    book.Worksheets(1).Range("B2").Select
    first.Zoom = 90
    Set second = book.NewWindow
    book.Worksheets(3).Select
    book.Worksheets(3).Range("C3").Select
    second.Zoom = 120
    first.Caption = "W1"
    second.Caption = "W2"
    Dim target As Window, activation As Window, stateValue As Variant

    Dim sn As Long, sd As String, ss As String, sh As String, sc As Long

    Set target = second
    Set activation = first
    stateValue = -4143
    Select Case mode
        Case 0: Set target = first
        Case 1: Set target = second
        Case 2: stateValue = -4140
        Case 3: Set target = first: stateValue = -4137: Set activation = second
        Case 4: Set target = first: stateValue = -4140
        Case 5: stateValue = "bad"
        Case 6: stateValue = 0
        Case 7: stateValue = Null
    End Select
    beforeFirst = State(first)
    beforeSecond = State(second)
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    If binding = 0 Then
        target.WindowState = stateValue

    sn = Err.Number: sd = Err.Description: ss = Err.Source: sh = Err.HelpFile: sc = Err.HelpContext

    setFirst = State(first)
    setSecond = State(second)
    Err.Clear
    activation.Activate
    an = Err.Number: ad = Err.Description: ac = Err.Source: ah = Err.HelpFile: ax = Err.HelpContext
    Err.Clear
    book.Saved = True
    Probe = Array(sn, sd, ss, sh, sc, an, ad, ac, ah, ax, beforeFirst, beforeSecond, setFirst, setSecond, State(first), State(second), State(Application.ActiveWindow), book.Windows.Count, Application.Windows.Count, book.Saved)

End Function

VERSION 1.0 CLASS
Attribute VB_Name = "Ledger"
Attribute VB_Base = "0{00020820-0000-0000-C000-000000000046}"
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = False
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = True
