Attribute VB_Name = "DriverModule"
' SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0
Option Explicit

Private Function Describe(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim title As String, position As String
    title = "[off]"
    position = "[off]"
    If target.HasTitle Then title = target.ChartTitle.Text
    If target.HasLegend Then position = CStr(target.Legend.Position)
    Describe = CStr(VarType(target)) & ":" & TypeName(target)
    Describe = Describe & "|title=" & CStr(target.HasTitle) & ":" & title
    Describe = Describe & "|legend=" & CStr(target.HasLegend) & ":" & position
    Describe = Describe & "|type=" & CStr(target.ChartType)
End Function


' Self-authored conformance probes, CC BY-SA 4.0.
Public Function AdvancedChartMarker() As String
    AdvancedChartMarker = "oxi-advanced-chart-20261106-v1"
End Function

Public Function OfPieProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal splitKind As Long, ByVal splitValue As Double, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object, group As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    If explicitLabels Then
        n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    stage = "group"
    Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
    If splitKind <> 0 Then
        stage = "split-type"
        group.SplitType = splitKind
        stage = "split-value"
        group.SplitValue = splitValue
    End If
    stage = "read"
    OfPieProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|split=" & CStr(group.SplitType) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    OfPieProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function BubbleProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal inputSizes As Variant, ByVal sizesKind As Long, ByVal typeAfterData As Boolean, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    If Not typeAfterData Then target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
    If explicitLabels Then
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    If typeAfterData Then
        stage = "type-after"
        target.ChartType = kind
    End If
    If sizesKind = 1 Then
        stage = "sizes-literal"
        item.BubbleSizes = inputSizes
    ElseIf sizesKind = 2 Then
        stage = "sizes-range"
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            Ledger.Cells(i + 1, 3).Value2 = inputSizes(LBound(inputSizes) + i)
        Next
        item.BubbleSizes = Ledger.Range(Ledger.Cells(1, 3), Ledger.Cells(n, 3))
    End If
    stage = "read"
    BubbleProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|sizes=" & CStr(VarType(item.BubbleSizes)) & ":" & CStr(item.BubbleSizes)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    BubbleProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function StateReport() As String
    Dim index As Long, anchor As Object, report As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    report = "sheet=" & Describe(PlotHost) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(PlotHost)
    report = report & "|embedded=" & CStr(Ledger.ChartObjects.Count)
    For index = 1 To Ledger.ChartObjects.Count
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects(index)
        report = report & "|object=" & anchor.Name & ":" & Describe(anchor.Chart) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(anchor.Chart)
        report = report & "|bounds=" & CStr(anchor.Left) & ":" & CStr(anchor.Top)
        report = report & ":" & CStr(anchor.Width) & ":" & CStr(anchor.Height)
    Next index
    StateReport = report
    Exit Function
Failed:
    StateReport = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function CaseProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If kind = 0 Then
        CaseProbe = "oxi-uniform-chart-20261106-v2"
        Exit Function
    End If
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    Select Case kind
    Case 1
        ' Observe the original chart or the newly created embedded chart.
    Case 2
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 3
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = "Revenue"
        target.HasLegend = False
    Case 4
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ""
    Case 5
        target.HasTitle = False
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 6
        target.HasTitle = False
    Case 7
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4131
    Case 8
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4107
    Case 9
        target.HasLegend = False
        target.HasLegend = True
    Case 10
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ChrW(&H58F2) & ChrW(&H4E0A) & " & <" & ChrW(&H96C6) & ChrW(&H8A08) & ">" & vbLf & "2026"
    Case 11
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Caption = "Caption"
    Case 12
        target.ChartType = 51
    Case Else
        Err.Raise 5, "UniformChart", "Unknown case"
    End Select
    CaseProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|objects=" & CStr(Ledger.ChartObjects.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    CaseProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Private Function TypedValues(ByVal value As Variant) As String
    Dim index As Long, result As String
    result = CStr(VarType(value)) & ":" & TypeName(value)
    If IsArray(value) Then
        result = result & "[" & CStr(LBound(value)) & "," & CStr(UBound(value)) & "]"
        For index = LBound(value) To UBound(value)
            result = result & "{" & CStr(VarType(value(index))) & ":" & CStr(value(index)) & "}"
        Next index
    Else
        result = result & ":" & CStr(value)
    End If
    TypedValues = result
End Function

Private Function DescribeSeries(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim index As Long, item As Object, result As String
    result = CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
    For index = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection(index)
        result = result & "|series=" & item.Name & ":" & item.Formula
        result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
    Next index
    DescribeSeries = result
End Function

Public Function ChartTypeProbe(ByVal chartType As Long, ByVal sourceKind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = chartType
    If sourceKind = 1 Then
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
        item.Name = "Revenue"
        item.Values = Array(1.25, 2.5, 3.75)
        item.XValues = Array("1", "2", "3")
    ElseIf sourceKind = 2 Then
        Ledger.Range("A1").Value2 = "Category"
        Ledger.Range("B1").Value2 = "Revenue"
        Ledger.Range("A2").Value2 = 1
        Ledger.Range("A3").Value2 = 2
        Ledger.Range("A4").Value2 = 3
        Ledger.Range("B2").Value2 = 1.25
        Ledger.Range("B3").Value2 = 2.5
        Ledger.Range("B4").Value2 = 3.75
        target.SetSourceData Ledger.Range("A1:B4")
    End If
    ChartTypeProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    ChartTypeProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

VERSION 1.0 CLASS
Attribute VB_Name = "PlotHost"
Attribute VB_Base = "0{00020821-0000-0000-C000-000000000046}"

Attribute VB_Name = "GroupContractProbe"
Option Explicit
Private Function TypedValues(ByVal v As Variant) As String
 Dim i As Long, s As String
 s = CStr(VarType(v)) & ":" & TypeName(v)
 If IsArray(v) Then
  s = s & "[" & CStr(LBound(v)) & "," & CStr(UBound(v)) & "]"
  For i = LBound(v) To UBound(v)
   s = s & "{" & CStr(VarType(v(i))) & ":" & CStr(v(i)) & "}"
  Next
 End If
 TypedValues = s
End Function
Public Function GroupProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal n As Long, ByVal embedded As Boolean, ByVal mode As Long, ByVal choice As Variant) As String
 Dim target As Object, item As Object, group As Object
 Dim values As Variant, labels As Variant, i As Long, stage As String, result As String
 On Error GoTo Failed
 stage = "target"
 If embedded Then
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160).Chart
 Else
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
 End If
 target.ChartType = kind
 If n > 0 Then
  Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
  ReDim values(0 To n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
   values(i) = i + 1
  Next
  item.Values = values
 End If
 stage = "group"
 Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
 stage = "assignment"
 Select Case mode
 Case 1
  ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
   labels(i) = (i + 1) * 10
  Next
  item.XValues = labels
 Case 2
  group.SplitType = choice
 Case 3
  group.SplitValue = choice
 Case 4
  item.Points(1).SecondaryPlot = choice
 Case 5
  item.Points(n).SecondaryPlot = choice
 Case 6
  item.Points(n + 1).SecondaryPlot = choice
 End Select
 result = "ok"
ReadState:
 On Error GoTo FailedRead
 result = result & "|count=" & CStr(target.ChartGroups.Count) & "|group=" & TypeName(group)
 result = result & "|split=" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitType)) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitType)
 result = result & ":" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitValue)) & ":" & TypeName(group.SplitValue) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
 result = result & "|size=" & CStr(group.SecondPlotSize)
 If n > 0 Then
  result = result & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count) & "|item=" & TypeName(item.Points.Item(1))
  result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
  If kind = 68 Or kind = 71 Then
   result = result & "|secondary="
   For i = 1 To item.Points.Count
    result = result & CStr(item.Points(i).SecondaryPlot) & ","
   Next
  End If
 End If
 GroupProbe = result
 Exit Function
Failed:
 result = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
 Resume ReadState
FailedRead:
 GroupProbe = result & "|read-error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "ChartAddContracts"
Option Explicit
Private Function StateOfBook() As String
 Dim i As Long, s As String, sh As Object
 s = CStr(ThisWorkbook.Charts.Count) & ":" & CStr(ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Count) & "|tabs="
 For i = 1 To ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count
  Set sh = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(i)
  s = s & TypeName(sh) & ":" & sh.Name & ";"
 Next
 StateOfBook = s & "|active=" & ActiveSheet.Name
End Function
Public Function ChartAddProbe(ByVal mode As Long, Optional ByVal choice As Variant) As String
 Dim target As Object, first As Object, labels As Variant, values As Variant
 Dim s As String, stage As String, ws As Object, i As Long, item As Object
 On Error GoTo Failed
 stage = "add"
 Select Case mode
 Case 0
  Set first = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
  s = first.Name
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
  s = s & ":" & target.Name
  target.Delete
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add

Private Function Describe(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim title As String, position As String

    position = "[off]"
    If target.HasTitle Then title = target.ChartTitle.Text
    If target.HasLegend Then position = CStr(target.Legend.Position)
    Describe = CStr(VarType(target)) & ":" & TypeName(target)
    Describe = Describe & "|title=" & CStr(target.HasTitle) & ":" & title
    Describe = Describe & "|legend=" & CStr(target.HasLegend) & ":" & position
    Describe = Describe & "|type=" & CStr(target.ChartType)

Public Function OfPieProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal splitKind As Long, ByVal splitValue As Double, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object, group As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    If explicitLabels Then
        n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    stage = "group"
    Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
    If splitKind <> 0 Then
        stage = "split-type"
        group.SplitType = splitKind
        stage = "split-value"
        group.SplitValue = splitValue
    End If
    stage = "read"
    OfPieProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|split=" & CStr(group.SplitType) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    OfPieProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function BubbleProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal inputSizes As Variant, ByVal sizesKind As Long, ByVal typeAfterData As Boolean, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    If Not typeAfterData Then target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
    If explicitLabels Then
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    If typeAfterData Then
        stage = "type-after"
        target.ChartType = kind
    End If
    If sizesKind = 1 Then
        stage = "sizes-literal"
        item.BubbleSizes = inputSizes
    ElseIf sizesKind = 2 Then

Private Function Describe(ByVal target As Object) As String

Public Function OfPieProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal splitKind As Long, ByVal splitValue As Double, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object, group As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    If explicitLabels Then
        n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    stage = "group"
    Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
    If splitKind <> 0 Then
        stage = "split-type"
        group.SplitType = splitKind
        stage = "split-value"
        group.SplitValue = splitValue
    End If
    stage = "read"
    OfPieProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|split=" & CStr(group.SplitType) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    OfPieProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function BubbleProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal inputSizes As Variant, ByVal sizesKind As Long, ByVal typeAfterData As Boolean, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    If Not typeAfterData Then target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
    If explicitLabels Then
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    If typeAfterData Then
        stage = "type-after"
        target.ChartType = kind
    End If
    If sizesKind = 1 Then
        stage = "sizes-literal"
        item.BubbleSizes = inputSizes
    ElseIf sizesKind = 2 Then
        stage = "sizes-range"
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            Ledger.Cells(i + 1, 3).Value2 = inputSizes(LBound(inputSizes) + i)
        Next
        item.BubbleSizes = Ledger.Range(Ledger.Cells(1, 3), Ledger.Cells(n, 3))
    End If
    stage = "read"
    BubbleProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|sizes=" & CStr(VarType(item.BubbleSizes)) & ":" & CStr(item.BubbleSizes)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function

    BubbleProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description

Public Function CaseProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If kind = 0 Then
        CaseProbe = "oxi-uniform-chart-20261106-v2"
        Exit Function
    End If
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    Select Case kind
    Case 1
        ' Observe the original chart or the newly created embedded chart.
    Case 2
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 3
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = "Revenue"
        target.HasLegend = False
    Case 4
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ""
    Case 5
        target.HasTitle = False
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 6
        target.HasTitle = False
    Case 7
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4131
    Case 8
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4107
    Case 9
        target.HasLegend = False
        target.HasLegend = True
    Case 10
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ChrW(&H58F2) & ChrW(&H4E0A) & " & <" & ChrW(&H96C6) & ChrW(&H8A08) & ">" & vbLf & "2026"
    Case 11
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Caption = "Caption"
    Case 12
        target.ChartType = 51
    Case Else
        Err.Raise 5, "UniformChart", "Unknown case"
    End Select
    CaseProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|objects=" & CStr(Ledger.ChartObjects.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    CaseProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Private Function TypedValues(ByVal value As Variant) As String
    Dim index As Long, result As String
    result = CStr(VarType(value)) & ":" & TypeName(value)
    If IsArray(value) Then
        result = result & "[" & CStr(LBound(value)) & "," & CStr(UBound(value)) & "]"
        For index = LBound(value) To UBound(value)
            result = result & "{" & CStr(VarType(value(index))) & ":" & CStr(value(index)) & "}"
        Next index
    Else
        result = result & ":" & CStr(value)
    End If
    TypedValues = result
End Function

Private Function DescribeSeries(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim index As Long, item As Object, result As String
    result = CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
    For index = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection(index)
        result = result & "|series=" & item.Name & ":" & item.Formula
        result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
    Next index
    DescribeSeries = result
End Function

Public Function ChartTypeProbe(ByVal chartType As Long, ByVal sourceKind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = chartType
    If sourceKind = 1 Then
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
        item.Name = "Revenue"
        item.Values = Array(1.25, 2.5, 3.75)
        item.XValues = Array("1", "2", "3")
    ElseIf sourceKind = 2 Then
        Ledger.Range("A1").Value2 = "Category"
        Ledger.Range("B1").Value2 = "Revenue"
        Ledger.Range("A2").Value2 = 1
        Ledger.Range("A3").Value2 = 2
        Ledger.Range("A4").Value2 = 3
        Ledger.Range("B2").Value2 = 1.25
        Ledger.Range("B3").Value2 = 2.5
        Ledger.Range("B4").Value2 = 3.75
        target.SetSourceData Ledger.Range("A1:B4")
    End If
    ChartTypeProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    ChartTypeProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function GroupProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal n As Long, ByVal embedded As Boolean, ByVal mode As Long, ByVal choice As Variant) As String
 Dim target As Object, item As Object, group As Object
 Dim values As Variant, labels As Variant, i As Long, stage As String, result As String
 On Error GoTo Failed
 stage = "target"
 If embedded Then
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160).Chart
 Else
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
 End If
 target.ChartType = kind
 If n > 0 Then
  Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
  ReDim values(0 To n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
   values(i) = i + 1
  Next
  item.Values = values
 End If
 stage = "group"
 Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
 stage = "assignment"
 Select Case mode
 Case 1
  ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
   labels(i) = (i + 1) * 10
  Next
  item.XValues = labels
 Case 2
  group.SplitType = choice
 Case 3
  group.SplitValue = choice
 Case 4
  item.Points(1).SecondaryPlot = choice
 Case 5
  item.Points(n).SecondaryPlot = choice
 Case 6
  item.Points(n + 1).SecondaryPlot = choice
 End Select
 result = "ok"
ReadState:
 On Error GoTo FailedRead
 result = result & "|count=" & CStr(target.ChartGroups.Count) & "|group=" & TypeName(group)
 result = result & "|split=" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitType)) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitType)
 result = result & ":" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitValue)) & ":" & TypeName(group.SplitValue) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
 result = result & "|size=" & CStr(group.SecondPlotSize)
 If n > 0 Then
  result = result & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count) & "|item=" & TypeName(item.Points.Item(1))
  result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
  If kind = 68 Or kind = 71 Then
   result = result & "|secondary="
   For i = 1 To item.Points.Count
    result = result & CStr(item.Points(i).SecondaryPlot) & ","
   Next
  End If
 End If
 GroupProbe = result
 Exit Function
Failed:
 result = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
 Resume ReadState
FailedRead:
 GroupProbe = result & "|read-error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

 stage = "read"

Private Function Describe(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim title As String, position As String
    title = "[off]"
    position = "[off]"
    If target.HasTitle Then title = target.ChartTitle.Text
    If target.HasLegend Then position = CStr(target.Legend.Position)
    Describe = CStr(VarType(target)) & ":" & TypeName(target)
    Describe = Describe & "|title=" & CStr(target.HasTitle) & ":" & title
    Describe = Describe & "|legend=" & CStr(target.HasLegend) & ":" & position
    Describe = Describe & "|type=" & CStr(target.ChartType)
End Function

Public Function OfPieProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal splitKind As Long, ByVal splitValue As Double, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object, group As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    If explicitLabels Then
        n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    stage = "group"
    Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
    If splitKind <> 0 Then
        stage = "split-type"
        group.SplitType = splitKind
        stage = "split-value"
        group.SplitValue = splitValue
    End If
    stage = "read"
    OfPieProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|split=" & CStr(group.SplitType) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    OfPieProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function BubbleProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal inputSizes As Variant, ByVal sizesKind As Long, ByVal typeAfterData As Boolean, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    If Not typeAfterData Then target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
    If explicitLabels Then
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    If typeAfterData Then
        stage = "type-after"
        target.ChartType = kind
    End If
    If sizesKind = 1 Then
        stage = "sizes-literal"
        item.BubbleSizes = inputSizes
    ElseIf sizesKind = 2 Then
        stage = "sizes-range"
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            Ledger.Cells(i + 1, 3).Value2 = inputSizes(LBound(inputSizes) + i)
        Next
        item.BubbleSizes = Ledger.Range(Ledger.Cells(1, 3), Ledger.Cells(n, 3))
    End If
    stage = "read"
    BubbleProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|sizes=" & CStr(VarType(item.BubbleSizes)) & ":" & CStr(item.BubbleSizes)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    BubbleProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function CaseProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If kind = 0 Then
        CaseProbe = "oxi-uniform-chart-20261106-v2"
        Exit Function
    End If
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    Select Case kind
    Case 1
        ' Observe the original chart or the newly created embedded chart.
    Case 2
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 3
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = "Revenue"
        target.HasLegend = False
    Case 4
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ""
    Case 5
        target.HasTitle = False
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 6
        target.HasTitle = False
    Case 7
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4131
    Case 8
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4107
    Case 9
        target.HasLegend = False
        target.HasLegend = True
    Case 10
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ChrW(&H58F2) & ChrW(&H4E0A) & " & <" & ChrW(&H96C6) & ChrW(&H8A08) & ">" & vbLf & "2026"
    Case 11
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Caption = "Caption"
    Case 12
        target.ChartType = 51
    Case Else
        Err.Raise 5, "UniformChart", "Unknown case"
    End Select
    CaseProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|objects=" & CStr(Ledger.ChartObjects.Count)
    Exit Function

    CaseProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Private Function TypedValues(ByVal value As Variant) As String
    Dim index As Long, result As String
    result = CStr(VarType(value)) & ":" & TypeName(value)
    If IsArray(value) Then
        result = result & "[" & CStr(LBound(value)) & "," & CStr(UBound(value)) & "]"
        For index = LBound(value) To UBound(value)
            result = result & "{" & CStr(VarType(value(index))) & ":" & CStr(value(index)) & "}"
        Next index
    Else
        result = result & ":" & CStr(value)
    End If
    TypedValues = result
End Function

Private Function DescribeSeries(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim index As Long, item As Object, result As String
    result = CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
    For index = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection(index)
        result = result & "|series=" & item.Name & ":" & item.Formula
        result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
    Next index
    DescribeSeries = result
End Function

Public Function ChartTypeProbe(ByVal chartType As Long, ByVal sourceKind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = chartType
    If sourceKind = 1 Then
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
        item.Name = "Revenue"
        item.Values = Array(1.25, 2.5, 3.75)
        item.XValues = Array("1", "2", "3")
    ElseIf sourceKind = 2 Then
        Ledger.Range("A1").Value2 = "Category"
        Ledger.Range("B1").Value2 = "Revenue"
        Ledger.Range("A2").Value2 = 1
        Ledger.Range("A3").Value2 = 2
        Ledger.Range("A4").Value2 = 3
        Ledger.Range("B2").Value2 = 1.25
        Ledger.Range("B3").Value2 = 2.5
        Ledger.Range("B4").Value2 = 3.75
        target.SetSourceData Ledger.Range("A1:B4")
    End If
    ChartTypeProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    ChartTypeProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function GroupProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal n As Long, ByVal embedded As Boolean, ByVal mode As Long, ByVal choice As Variant) As String

 Dim target As Object, first As Object, labels As Variant, values As Variant

 Case 0

  s = s & ":" & target.Name
  target.Delete
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add

  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Before:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(1))
 Case 3
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(After:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count))

  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
 End Select
 stage = "read"

  s = s & "|plot=" & CStr(target.ChartType) & "|series=" & CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)

 Exit Function

Private Function Describe(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim title As String, position As String
    title = "[off]"
    position = "[off]"
    If target.HasTitle Then title = target.ChartTitle.Text
    If target.HasLegend Then position = CStr(target.Legend.Position)
    Describe = CStr(VarType(target)) & ":" & TypeName(target)
    Describe = Describe & "|title=" & CStr(target.HasTitle) & ":" & title
    Describe = Describe & "|legend=" & CStr(target.HasLegend) & ":" & position
    Describe = Describe & "|type=" & CStr(target.ChartType)
End Function


' Self-authored conformance probes, CC BY-SA 4.0.
Public Function AdvancedChartMarker() As String
    AdvancedChartMarker = "oxi-advanced-chart-20261106-v1"
End Function

Public Function OfPieProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal splitKind As Long, ByVal splitValue As Double, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object, group As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    If explicitLabels Then
        n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    stage = "group"
    Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
    If splitKind <> 0 Then
        stage = "split-type"
        group.SplitType = splitKind
        stage = "split-value"
        group.SplitValue = splitValue
    End If
    stage = "read"
    OfPieProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|split=" & CStr(group.SplitType) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    OfPieProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function BubbleProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal inputSizes As Variant, ByVal sizesKind As Long, ByVal typeAfterData As Boolean, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    If Not typeAfterData Then target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
    If explicitLabels Then
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    If typeAfterData Then
        stage = "type-after"
        target.ChartType = kind
    End If
    If sizesKind = 1 Then
        stage = "sizes-literal"
        item.BubbleSizes = inputSizes
    ElseIf sizesKind = 2 Then
        stage = "sizes-range"
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            Ledger.Cells(i + 1, 3).Value2 = inputSizes(LBound(inputSizes) + i)
        Next
        item.BubbleSizes = Ledger.Range(Ledger.Cells(1, 3), Ledger.Cells(n, 3))
    End If
    stage = "read"
    BubbleProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|sizes=" & CStr(VarType(item.BubbleSizes)) & ":" & CStr(item.BubbleSizes)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    BubbleProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function StateReport() As String
    Dim index As Long, anchor As Object, report As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    report = "sheet=" & Describe(PlotHost) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(PlotHost)
    report = report & "|embedded=" & CStr(Ledger.ChartObjects.Count)
    For index = 1 To Ledger.ChartObjects.Count
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects(index)

Public Function CaseProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String

        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    Select Case kind

    Case 2
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 3
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = "Revenue"
        target.HasLegend = False
    Case 4
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ""
    Case 5
        target.HasTitle = False
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 6
        target.HasTitle = False
    Case 7
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4131
    Case 8
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4107
    Case 9
        target.HasLegend = False
        target.HasLegend = True
    Case 10
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ChrW(&H58F2) & ChrW(&H4E0A) & " & <" & ChrW(&H96C6) & ChrW(&H8A08) & ">" & vbLf & "2026"
    Case 11
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Caption = "Caption"
    Case 12
        target.ChartType = 51
    Case Else
        Err.Raise 5, "UniformChart", "Unknown case"

Private Function TypedValues(ByVal value As Variant) As String

Private Function DescribeSeries(ByVal target As Object) As String

        result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)

    DescribeSeries = result

Public Function ChartTypeProbe(ByVal chartType As Long, ByVal sourceKind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String

        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = chartType
    If sourceKind = 1 Then

        item.Name = "Revenue"
        item.Values = Array(1.25, 2.5, 3.75)

        Ledger.Range("A2").Value2 = 1
        Ledger.Range("A3").Value2 = 2
        Ledger.Range("A4").Value2 = 3
        Ledger.Range("B2").Value2 = 1.25
        Ledger.Range("B3").Value2 = 2.5
        Ledger.Range("B4").Value2 = 3.75
        target.SetSourceData Ledger.Range("A1:B4")

    ChartTypeProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    Exit Function

Public Function GroupProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal n As Long, ByVal embedded As Boolean, ByVal mode As Long, ByVal choice As Variant) As String
 Dim target As Object, item As Object, group As Object
 Dim values As Variant, labels As Variant, i As Long, stage As String, result As String
 On Error GoTo Failed
 stage = "target"
 If embedded Then
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160).Chart
 Else
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
 End If
 target.ChartType = kind
 If n > 0 Then
  Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
  ReDim values(0 To n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
   values(i) = i + 1
  Next
  item.Values = values
 End If
 stage = "group"
 Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
 stage = "assignment"
 Select Case mode
 Case 1
  ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
   labels(i) = (i + 1) * 10
  Next
  item.XValues = labels
 Case 2
  group.SplitType = choice
 Case 3
  group.SplitValue = choice
 Case 4
  item.Points(1).SecondaryPlot = choice
 Case 5
  item.Points(n).SecondaryPlot = choice
 Case 6
  item.Points(n + 1).SecondaryPlot = choice
 End Select
 result = "ok"

 On Error GoTo FailedRead
 result = result & "|count=" & CStr(target.ChartGroups.Count) & "|group=" & TypeName(group)
 result = result & "|split=" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitType)) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitType)
 result = result & ":" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitValue)) & ":" & TypeName(group.SplitValue) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)

  result = result & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count) & "|item=" & TypeName(item.Points.Item(1))
  result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)

   result = result & "|secondary="

 Resume ReadState

Private Function Describe(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim title As String, position As String
    title = "[off]"
    position = "[off]"
    If target.HasTitle Then title = target.ChartTitle.Text
    If target.HasLegend Then position = CStr(target.Legend.Position)
    Describe = CStr(VarType(target)) & ":" & TypeName(target)
    Describe = Describe & "|title=" & CStr(target.HasTitle) & ":" & title
    Describe = Describe & "|legend=" & CStr(target.HasLegend) & ":" & position
    Describe = Describe & "|type=" & CStr(target.ChartType)
End Function

Public Function AdvancedChartMarker() As String
    AdvancedChartMarker = "oxi-advanced-chart-20261106-v1"
End Function

Public Function OfPieProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal splitKind As Long, ByVal splitValue As Double, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object, group As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    If explicitLabels Then
        n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    stage = "group"
    Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
    If splitKind <> 0 Then
        stage = "split-type"
        group.SplitType = splitKind
        stage = "split-value"
        group.SplitValue = splitValue
    End If
    stage = "read"
    OfPieProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|split=" & CStr(group.SplitType) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    OfPieProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function BubbleProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal inputSizes As Variant, ByVal sizesKind As Long, ByVal typeAfterData As Boolean, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    If Not typeAfterData Then target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
    If explicitLabels Then
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    If typeAfterData Then
        stage = "type-after"
        target.ChartType = kind
    End If
    If sizesKind = 1 Then
        stage = "sizes-literal"
        item.BubbleSizes = inputSizes
    ElseIf sizesKind = 2 Then
        stage = "sizes-range"
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            Ledger.Cells(i + 1, 3).Value2 = inputSizes(LBound(inputSizes) + i)
        Next
        item.BubbleSizes = Ledger.Range(Ledger.Cells(1, 3), Ledger.Cells(n, 3))
    End If
    stage = "read"
    BubbleProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|sizes=" & CStr(VarType(item.BubbleSizes)) & ":" & CStr(item.BubbleSizes)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    BubbleProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function StateReport() As String
    Dim index As Long, anchor As Object, report As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    report = "sheet=" & Describe(PlotHost) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(PlotHost)
    report = report & "|embedded=" & CStr(Ledger.ChartObjects.Count)
    For index = 1 To Ledger.ChartObjects.Count
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects(index)
        report = report & "|object=" & anchor.Name & ":" & Describe(anchor.Chart) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(anchor.Chart)
        report = report & "|bounds=" & CStr(anchor.Left) & ":" & CStr(anchor.Top)
        report = report & ":" & CStr(anchor.Width) & ":" & CStr(anchor.Height)
    Next index
    StateReport = report
    Exit Function
Failed:
    StateReport = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function CaseProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If kind = 0 Then
        CaseProbe = "oxi-uniform-chart-20261106-v2"
        Exit Function
    End If
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    Select Case kind
    Case 1
        ' Observe the original chart or the newly created embedded chart.
    Case 2
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 3
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = "Revenue"
        target.HasLegend = False
    Case 4
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ""
    Case 5
        target.HasTitle = False
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 6
        target.HasTitle = False
    Case 7
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4131
    Case 8
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4107
    Case 9
        target.HasLegend = False
        target.HasLegend = True
    Case 10
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ChrW(&H58F2) & ChrW(&H4E0A) & " & <" & ChrW(&H96C6) & ChrW(&H8A08) & ">" & vbLf & "2026"
    Case 11
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Caption = "Caption"
    Case 12
        target.ChartType = 51
    Case Else
        Err.Raise 5, "UniformChart", "Unknown case"
    End Select
    CaseProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|objects=" & CStr(Ledger.ChartObjects.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    CaseProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Private Function TypedValues(ByVal value As Variant) As String
    Dim index As Long, result As String
    result = CStr(VarType(value)) & ":" & TypeName(value)
    If IsArray(value) Then
        result = result & "[" & CStr(LBound(value)) & "," & CStr(UBound(value)) & "]"
        For index = LBound(value) To UBound(value)
            result = result & "{" & CStr(VarType(value(index))) & ":" & CStr(value(index)) & "}"
        Next index
    Else
        result = result & ":" & CStr(value)
    End If
    TypedValues = result
End Function

Private Function DescribeSeries(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim index As Long, item As Object, result As String
    result = CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
    For index = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection(index)
        result = result & "|series=" & item.Name & ":" & item.Formula
        result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
    Next index
    DescribeSeries = result
End Function

Public Function ChartTypeProbe(ByVal chartType As Long, ByVal sourceKind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = chartType
    If sourceKind = 1 Then
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
        item.Name = "Revenue"
        item.Values = Array(1.25, 2.5, 3.75)
        item.XValues = Array("1", "2", "3")
    ElseIf sourceKind = 2 Then
        Ledger.Range("A1").Value2 = "Category"
        Ledger.Range("B1").Value2 = "Revenue"
        Ledger.Range("A2").Value2 = 1
        Ledger.Range("A3").Value2 = 2
        Ledger.Range("A4").Value2 = 3
        Ledger.Range("B2").Value2 = 1.25
        Ledger.Range("B3").Value2 = 2.5
        Ledger.Range("B4").Value2 = 3.75
        target.SetSourceData Ledger.Range("A1:B4")
    End If
    ChartTypeProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    ChartTypeProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Option Explicit
Private Function TypedValues(ByVal v As Variant) As String
 Dim i As Long, s As String
 s = CStr(VarType(v)) & ":" & TypeName(v)
 If IsArray(v) Then
  s = s & "[" & CStr(LBound(v)) & "," & CStr(UBound(v)) & "]"
  For i = LBound(v) To UBound(v)
   s = s & "{" & CStr(VarType(v(i))) & ":" & CStr(v(i)) & "}"
  Next
 End If
 TypedValues = s
End Function
Public Function GroupProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal n As Long, ByVal embedded As Boolean, ByVal mode As Long, ByVal choice As Variant) As String
 Dim target As Object, item As Object, group As Object
 Dim values As Variant, labels As Variant, i As Long, stage As String, result As String
 On Error GoTo Failed
 stage = "target"
 If embedded Then
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160).Chart
 Else
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
 End If
 target.ChartType = kind
 If n > 0 Then
  Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
  ReDim values(0 To n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
   values(i) = i + 1
  Next
  item.Values = values
 End If
 stage = "group"
 Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
 stage = "assignment"
 Select Case mode
 Case 1
  ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
   labels(i) = (i + 1) * 10
  Next
  item.XValues = labels
 Case 2
  group.SplitType = choice
 Case 3
  group.SplitValue = choice
 Case 4
  item.Points(1).SecondaryPlot = choice
 Case 5
  item.Points(n).SecondaryPlot = choice
 Case 6
  item.Points(n + 1).SecondaryPlot = choice
 End Select
 result = "ok"
ReadState:
 On Error GoTo FailedRead
 result = result & "|count=" & CStr(target.ChartGroups.Count) & "|group=" & TypeName(group)
 result = result & "|split=" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitType)) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitType)
 result = result & ":" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitValue)) & ":" & TypeName(group.SplitValue) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
 result = result & "|size=" & CStr(group.SecondPlotSize)
 If n > 0 Then
  result = result & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count) & "|item=" & TypeName(item.Points.Item(1))
  result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
  If kind = 68 Or kind = 71 Then
   result = result & "|secondary="
   For i = 1 To item.Points.Count
    result = result & CStr(item.Points(i).SecondaryPlot) & ","
   Next
  End If
 End If
 GroupProbe = result
 Exit Function
Failed:
 result = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
 Resume ReadState
FailedRead:
 GroupProbe = result & "|read-error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "ChartAddContracts"
Option Explicit
Private Function StateOfBook() As String
 Dim i As Long, s As String, sh As Object

 For i = 1 To ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count
  Set sh = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(i)

 Next
 StateOfBook = s & "|active=" & ActiveSheet.Name
End Function
Public Function ChartAddProbe(ByVal mode As Long, Optional ByVal choice As Variant) As String
 Dim target As Object, first As Object, labels As Variant, values As Variant
 Dim s As String, stage As String, ws As Object, i As Long, item As Object
 On Error GoTo Failed
 stage = "add"
 Select Case mode
 Case 0
  Set first = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
  s = first.Name
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
  s = s & ":" & target.Name
  target.Delete
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
  s = s & ":" & target.Name
 Case 1
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Count:=choice)
 Case 2
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Before:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(1))
 Case 3
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(After:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count))
 Case 4
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Before:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(1), After:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count))
 Case 5
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Type:=choice)
 Case 6
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Add(Type:=choice)
 Case 7
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add(Before:=ThisWorkbook)
 Case 8
  Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1)
  ws.Activate
  ws.Range("A1").Value2 = "Category"
  ws.Range("B1").Value2 = "Revenue"
  ws.Range("A2").Value2 = "North"
  ws.Range("A3").Value2 = "East"
  ws.Range("A4").Value2 = "West"
  ws.Range("B2").Value2 = 10
  ws.Range("B3").Value2 = 20
  ws.Range("B4").Value2 = 30
  ws.Range("A1:B4").Select
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
 End Select
 stage = "read"
 s = s & "|result=" & TypeName(target) & ":" & target.Name & ":" & CStr(target.Parent Is ThisWorkbook)
 If TypeName(target) = "Chart" Then
  s = s & "|plot=" & CStr(target.ChartType) & "|series=" & CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
  For i = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
   Set item = target.SeriesCollection(i)
   s = s & "|" & item.Name & ":" & item.Formula
  Next
 End If
 ChartAddProbe = "ok|" & s & "|" & StateOfBook()
 Exit Function
Failed:
 ChartAddProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description & "|" & StateOfBook()
End Function

Private Function ArrayText(ByVal v As Variant) As String

  Next
 ElseIf Not IsNull(v) And Not IsError(v) Then
  s = s & "{" & CStr(v) & "}"
 End If
 ArrayText = s
End Function
Private Function SeriesMember(ByVal item As Object, ByVal memberName As String) As String
 On Error GoTo Failed
 Select Case memberName
 Case "Name"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.Name)
 Case "Formula"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.Formula)
 Case "Values"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.Values)
 Case "XValues"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.XValues)
 Case "BubbleSizes"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.BubbleSizes)
 Case "Points"
  SeriesMember = ArrayText(item.Points.Count)
 Case Else

 End Select
 Exit Function
Failed:
 SeriesMember = "error(" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & Err.Source & ":" & Err.Description & ")"
End Function
Private Function ChartState(ByVal target As Object) As String
 Dim s As String, item As Object, group As Object, i As Long, j As Long
 s = CStr(target.ChartType) & "|title=" & CStr(target.HasTitle)
 If target.HasTitle Then s = s & ":" & target.ChartTitle.Text
 s = s & "|legend=" & CStr(target.HasLegend)
 If target.HasLegend Then s = s & ":" & CStr(target.Legend.Position)
 s = s & "|groups=" & CStr(target.ChartGroups.Count)
 Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
 s = s & "|split=" & CStr(group.SplitType) & ":" & ArrayText(group.SplitValue)
 s = s & "|size=" & CStr(group.SecondPlotSize)
 s = s & "|series=" & CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
 For i = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
  Set item = target.SeriesCollection(i)
  s = s & "|s=" & SeriesMember(item, "Name") & ":" & SeriesMember(item, "Formula")
  s = s & "|v=" & SeriesMember(item, "Values") & "|x=" & SeriesMember(item, "XValues")
  s = s & "|points=" & SeriesMember(item, "Points")
  If target.ChartType = 68 Or target.ChartType = 71 Then
   s = s & "|secondary="
   For j = 1 To item.Points.Count
    s = s & CStr(item.Points(j).SecondaryPlot) & ","
   Next
  End If
  If target.ChartType = 15 Or target.ChartType = 87 Then s = s & "|sizes=" & SeriesMember(item, "BubbleSizes")
 Next
 ChartState = s
End Function
Public Function BoundaryState() As String

Private Function Describe(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim title As String, position As String
    title = "[off]"
    position = "[off]"
    If target.HasTitle Then title = target.ChartTitle.Text
    If target.HasLegend Then position = CStr(target.Legend.Position)
    Describe = CStr(VarType(target)) & ":" & TypeName(target)
    Describe = Describe & "|title=" & CStr(target.HasTitle) & ":" & title
    Describe = Describe & "|legend=" & CStr(target.HasLegend) & ":" & position
    Describe = Describe & "|type=" & CStr(target.ChartType)
End Function

Public Function AdvancedChartMarker() As String

Public Function OfPieProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal splitKind As Long, ByVal splitValue As Double, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object, group As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    If explicitLabels Then
        n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    stage = "group"
    Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
    If splitKind <> 0 Then
        stage = "split-type"
        group.SplitType = splitKind
        stage = "split-value"
        group.SplitValue = splitValue
    End If
    stage = "read"
    OfPieProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|split=" & CStr(group.SplitType) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    OfPieProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function BubbleProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal inputSizes As Variant, ByVal sizesKind As Long, ByVal typeAfterData As Boolean, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    If Not typeAfterData Then target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
    If explicitLabels Then
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    If typeAfterData Then
        stage = "type-after"
        target.ChartType = kind
    End If
    If sizesKind = 1 Then
        stage = "sizes-literal"
        item.BubbleSizes = inputSizes
    ElseIf sizesKind = 2 Then
        stage = "sizes-range"
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            Ledger.Cells(i + 1, 3).Value2 = inputSizes(LBound(inputSizes) + i)
        Next
        item.BubbleSizes = Ledger.Range(Ledger.Cells(1, 3), Ledger.Cells(n, 3))
    End If
    stage = "read"
    BubbleProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|sizes=" & CStr(VarType(item.BubbleSizes)) & ":" & CStr(item.BubbleSizes)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    BubbleProbe = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Public Function CaseProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If kind = 0 Then
        CaseProbe = "oxi-uniform-chart-20261106-v2"
        Exit Function
    End If
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    Select Case kind
    Case 1
        ' Observe the original chart or the newly created embedded chart.
    Case 2
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 3
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = "Revenue"
        target.HasLegend = False
    Case 4
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ""
    Case 5
        target.HasTitle = False
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 6
        target.HasTitle = False
    Case 7
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4131
    Case 8
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4107
    Case 9
        target.HasLegend = False
        target.HasLegend = True
    Case 10
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ChrW(&H58F2) & ChrW(&H4E0A) & " & <" & ChrW(&H96C6) & ChrW(&H8A08) & ">" & vbLf & "2026"
    Case 11

        target.ChartTitle.Caption = "Caption"

    CaseProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description

Private Function TypedValues(ByVal value As Variant) As String
    Dim index As Long, result As String
    result = CStr(VarType(value)) & ":" & TypeName(value)
    If IsArray(value) Then
        result = result & "[" & CStr(LBound(value)) & "," & CStr(UBound(value)) & "]"
        For index = LBound(value) To UBound(value)
            result = result & "{" & CStr(VarType(value(index))) & ":" & CStr(value(index)) & "}"
        Next index
    Else
        result = result & ":" & CStr(value)
    End If
    TypedValues = result
End Function

Private Function DescribeSeries(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim index As Long, item As Object, result As String
    result = CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
    For index = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection(index)
        result = result & "|series=" & item.Name & ":" & item.Formula
        result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
    Next index
    DescribeSeries = result
End Function

Public Function ChartTypeProbe(ByVal chartType As Long, ByVal sourceKind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = chartType
    If sourceKind = 1 Then
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
        item.Name = "Revenue"
        item.Values = Array(1.25, 2.5, 3.75)
        item.XValues = Array("1", "2", "3")
    ElseIf sourceKind = 2 Then
        Ledger.Range("A1").Value2 = "Category"
        Ledger.Range("B1").Value2 = "Revenue"
        Ledger.Range("A2").Value2 = 1
        Ledger.Range("A3").Value2 = 2
        Ledger.Range("A4").Value2 = 3
        Ledger.Range("B2").Value2 = 1.25
        Ledger.Range("B3").Value2 = 2.5
        Ledger.Range("B4").Value2 = 3.75
        target.SetSourceData Ledger.Range("A1:B4")
    End If
    ChartTypeProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    ChartTypeProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description

    Describe = Describe & "|title=" & CStr(target.HasTitle) & ":" & title

Public Function OfPieProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal splitKind As Long, ByVal splitValue As Double, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object, group As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String

    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = kind

    item.Name = "Revenue"

    item.Values = inputValues

        n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    stage = "group"
    Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
    If splitKind <> 0 Then
        stage = "split-type"
        group.SplitType = splitKind
        stage = "split-value"
        group.SplitValue = splitValue
    End If
    stage = "read"
    OfPieProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|split=" & CStr(group.SplitType) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count)

Public Function BubbleProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal inputSizes As Variant, ByVal sizesKind As Long, ByVal typeAfterData As Boolean, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    If Not typeAfterData Then target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
    If explicitLabels Then
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    If typeAfterData Then
        stage = "type-after"
        target.ChartType = kind
    End If
    If sizesKind = 1 Then
        stage = "sizes-literal"
        item.BubbleSizes = inputSizes
    ElseIf sizesKind = 2 Then
        stage = "sizes-range"
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            Ledger.Cells(i + 1, 3).Value2 = inputSizes(LBound(inputSizes) + i)
        Next
        item.BubbleSizes = Ledger.Range(Ledger.Cells(1, 3), Ledger.Cells(n, 3))
    End If
    stage = "read"
    BubbleProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|sizes=" & CStr(VarType(item.BubbleSizes)) & ":" & CStr(item.BubbleSizes)

Public Function CaseProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If kind = 0 Then
        CaseProbe = "oxi-uniform-chart-20261106-v2"
        Exit Function
    End If
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    Select Case kind
    Case 1
        ' Observe the original chart or the newly created embedded chart.
    Case 2
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 3
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = "Revenue"
        target.HasLegend = False
    Case 4
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ""
    Case 5
        target.HasTitle = False
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 6
        target.HasTitle = False
    Case 7
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4131
    Case 8
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4107
    Case 9
        target.HasLegend = False
        target.HasLegend = True
    Case 10
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ChrW(&H58F2) & ChrW(&H4E0A) & " & <" & ChrW(&H96C6) & ChrW(&H8A08) & ">" & vbLf & "2026"
    Case 11
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Caption = "Caption"
    Case 12
        target.ChartType = 51
    Case Else
        Err.Raise 5, "UniformChart", "Unknown case"
    End Select
    CaseProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|objects=" & CStr(Ledger.ChartObjects.Count)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    CaseProbe = "error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

Private Function TypedValues(ByVal value As Variant) As String
    Dim index As Long, result As String
    result = CStr(VarType(value)) & ":" & TypeName(value)
    If IsArray(value) Then
        result = result & "[" & CStr(LBound(value)) & "," & CStr(UBound(value)) & "]"
        For index = LBound(value) To UBound(value)
            result = result & "{" & CStr(VarType(value(index))) & ":" & CStr(value(index)) & "}"
        Next index
    Else
        result = result & ":" & CStr(value)
    End If
    TypedValues = result
End Function

Private Function DescribeSeries(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim index As Long, item As Object, result As String
    result = CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
    For index = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection(index)
        result = result & "|series=" & item.Name & ":" & item.Formula
        result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
    Next index
    DescribeSeries = result
End Function

Public Function GroupProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal n As Long, ByVal embedded As Boolean, ByVal mode As Long, ByVal choice As Variant) As String
 Dim target As Object, item As Object, group As Object
 Dim values As Variant, labels As Variant, i As Long, stage As String, result As String
 On Error GoTo Failed
 stage = "target"
 If embedded Then
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160).Chart
 Else
  Set target = ThisWorkbook.Charts.Add
 End If
 target.ChartType = kind
 If n > 0 Then
  Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
  ReDim values(0 To n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
   values(i) = i + 1
  Next
  item.Values = values
 End If
 stage = "group"
 Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
 stage = "assignment"
 Select Case mode
 Case 1
  ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
  For i = 0 To n - 1
   labels(i) = (i + 1) * 10
  Next
  item.XValues = labels
 Case 2
  group.SplitType = choice
 Case 3
  group.SplitValue = choice
 Case 4
  item.Points(1).SecondaryPlot = choice
 Case 5
  item.Points(n).SecondaryPlot = choice
 Case 6
  item.Points(n + 1).SecondaryPlot = choice
 End Select
 result = "ok"
ReadState:
 On Error GoTo FailedRead
 result = result & "|count=" & CStr(target.ChartGroups.Count) & "|group=" & TypeName(group)
 result = result & "|split=" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitType)) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitType)
 result = result & ":" & CStr(VarType(group.SplitValue)) & ":" & TypeName(group.SplitValue) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)
 result = result & "|size=" & CStr(group.SecondPlotSize)
 If n > 0 Then
  result = result & "|points=" & CStr(item.Points.Count) & "|item=" & TypeName(item.Points.Item(1))
  result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
  If kind = 68 Or kind = 71 Then
   result = result & "|secondary="
   For i = 1 To item.Points.Count
    result = result & CStr(item.Points(i).SecondaryPlot) & ","
   Next
  End If
 End If
 GroupProbe = result
 Exit Function
Failed:
 result = "error|" & stage & "|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & Err.Description
 Resume ReadState
FailedRead:
 GroupProbe = result & "|read-error|" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Description
End Function

  s = s & "|plot=" & CStr(target.ChartType) & "|series=" & CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)

Private Function ChartState(ByVal target As Object) As String

 s = s & "|size=" & CStr(group.SecondPlotSize)
 s = s & "|series=" & CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
 For i = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
  Set item = target.SeriesCollection(i)
  s = s & "|s=" & SeriesMember(item, "Name") & ":" & SeriesMember(item, "Formula")
  s = s & "|v=" & SeriesMember(item, "Values") & "|x=" & SeriesMember(item, "XValues")
  s = s & "|points=" & SeriesMember(item, "Points")
  If target.ChartType = 68 Or target.ChartType = 71 Then
   s = s & "|secondary="
   For j = 1 To item.Points.Count
    s = s & CStr(item.Points(j).SecondaryPlot) & ","
   Next
  End If
  If target.ChartType = 15 Or target.ChartType = 87 Then s = s & "|sizes=" & SeriesMember(item, "BubbleSizes")

Public Function BoundaryState() As String
